title: Geometry Dart 3D
description:
About Geometry Dart 3D
Geometry Dart 3D is a free online arcade skill game where you guide a sleek arrow through neon corridors packed with spiky obstacles.  If you enjoy Geometry Dash and wave-style runners, this one will feel right at home.  The 3D grid walls and glowing orange hazards give each run a bright, retro look, and the one-button control makes it easy to start and tough to master. 
The game has three modes: Classic levels, an Endless run, and a head-to-head 2 Player mode.

title: Stack Fire Ball
description:
Stack Fire Ball is an addictive arcade game where you drop a blazing fireball through a tower of rotating platforms, smashing through colored layers while carefully avoiding the black tiles.  Simple to learn, impossible to put down.  No download needed — play free in your browser. 

How to Play Stack Fire Ball
Tap or click to release the fireball and let it fall through the rotating stack.

title: Mahjong
description: Mahjong Online is a game of patience, skill, and a bit of luck.  In this version of a decades-old game, your goal will be to match identical tiles to remove them from the board until none remain.  The difficulty comes with this rule: only free tiles can be picked.  So, blocked tiles must be open on at least one side.

title: Love Tester
description:
About Love Tester
Love Tester is a free online novelty game that lets you find out — at least for fun — how compatible you are with your crush.  Type in your name and theirs, hit the big heart at the center of the screen, and the love calculator instantly generates a compatibility percentage along with a playful evaluation of your chances.  Think of it as a digital spin on old-fashioned fortune telling: instead of tarot cards or tea leaves, Love Tester uses a name-based algorithm to give you a lighthearted verdict on your romantic prospects. 
Playable free in your browser with no download or account required, Love Tester works equally well on desktop and mobile.

title: Drift King
description:
Drift King stands out among online drift games, offering a unique experience where you can witness the smoke you leave behind from the rearview window.  This game surrounds you in every realistic detail, from its premium 3D visuals to the choice of 10 sports cars and 6 maps. 
The comprehensive tuning options further enhance the game, making it a complete package for drifting enthusiasts. 


Controls

WASD or arrow keys: Move car 
M: Rearview Mirror
C: Change Carnera
R: Reset Car
U: Toggle between KMH and MPH
I: Start/Stop Engine
P: Fullscreen



How To Play Drift King
The traditional approach in a car game would be to give zero cash to the player at the beginning.

title: Real Flight Simulator
description:
About Real Flight Simulator
Real Flight Simulator delivers an authentic browser-based flying experience, letting you choose from multiple aircraft — from small propeller planes to larger jets — and take off from a variety of runways to soar through realistic skies.  Whether you want a relaxed scenic cruise above the clouds or a tense precision landing challenge on a short runway, the game gives you full control of the cockpit, with each aircraft handling noticeably differently in terms of speed, turning, and stall behavior. 
Real Flight Simulator runs free in your browser with no download or installation needed, and is accessible on both desktop and mobile devices.  The controls are built to feel like genuine flight mechanics rather than an arcade shortcut, which means it rewards patience and practice — small, deliberate stick inputs get you a smooth flight, while overcorrecting tends to send you into a spin.

title: Masked Special Forces
description:
Masked Special Forces is a multiplayer first-person shooter game with a myriad of customization options.  The game puts you in the shoes of a commander in the battle arena.  As a talented warrior, team up, strategize, and take down the opponents one by one.  
Access to an array of upgradable weapons, armory, kill messages, and victory dances on the main menu.

title: GTA Simulator
description: You know that famous GTA video game series, right?  Well, meet its online and free version on OnlineGames. io.  GTA Simulator is a simulator game that you can play on your web browser without the need to download.

title: Stickman Parkour
description:
About Stickman Parkour
Stickman Parkour is a free online platformer from FreezeNova Games Studio built around easy-to-learn but hard-to-master movement mechanics.  You play as a tiny stick figure on a mission to collect golden keys hidden throughout 30 levels, each key unlocking an ancient gate that leads deeper into the adventure.  Along the way you'll dodge sharp spikes, swing across gaps on ropes, and swim through water sections, all in service of reaching the very last gate with the final golden key in hand. 
Stickman Parkour runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, playable on desktop with keyboard controls or on mobile using on-screen buttons.

title: Highway Traffic
description:
Highway Traffic
Highway Traffic is a free online driving game built around dodging traffic on a busy highway, where other vehicles slow down, speed up, or stop abruptly without warning.  Every second demands your full attention, since a moment of distraction can end your run in a crash.  The longer you survive without hitting another car, the more points you rack up and the more upgrades you unlock, making Highway Traffic a game that rewards focus and quick reflexes over brute-force speed. 
Highway Traffic runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, and it offers a wide range of car models, styles, and weather settings to change up the challenge.

title: Stickman GTA City
description: You've been digging the internet for ages, looking for a free GTA game to play on your browser, only to end up with games that disappoint faster than a balloon losing air.  You might have given up hope, reminiscing about the days of cruising through GTA San Andreas or Vice City with your bro.  Think of how much you missed even hearing that iconic sound, the one that plays right as the screen fades to black with a bold "Wasted! " slapped across it?

title: Snaker io
description:
Snaker io is a multiplayer snake game in which you guide your little snake on an arena full of neon food pellets.  To grow the snake, collect as many pellets as you can while trying to survive in the arena with many other snakes.  Avoid crashing into others or eating your own tail to live longer in this snake classic arcade game! 


Controls

Mouse: Control the Snake
Spacebar/Left-Shift/LMB: Speed Up
Alternatively, you can use the WASD keys or the Arrow keys to steer.

title: Steal Brainrots Multiplayer
description:
About Steal Brainrots Multiplayer
Steal Brainrots Multiplayer is a free online multiplayer game where building an empire isn't enough — you have to protect it, too.  Grow a base full of Brainrot characters that generate cash automatically, then sneak into other players' bases to steal their most valuable creatures before they steal yours back.  The core loop mixes idle-style income with real-time PvP risk: Brainrots sit on collection pads earning cash per second while you're away, but leaving your base unguarded means a rival can walk in and grab your rarest units. 
Brainrots span a wide rarity ladder — Common, Rare, Epic, Mythic, Brainrot God, and ultra-rare Secret units — each generating a different cash-per-second rate, with guaranteed spawn timers and random Lucky Blocks keeping the action moving.

title: Guerrillas io
description: You are a particular elite team member and are called into battle.  Your weapons are ready, and your equipment is prepared.  All your team needs is you.  Guerrillas io is a multiplayer battling game that you can play online.

title: Crazy Strike Force
description:
About Crazy Strike Force
Crazy Strike Force is a free online multiplayer first-person shooter that throws you straight into intense battle competitions against real players from around the world.  You customize your soldier's look, pick from a huge armory of more than 20 weapons — including the Magnum, MP5K, M870, SC-AR, MGL, Tommy gun, M4A1, AWP, and Crossbow — and equip skills like Quickdraw ammo, Silence Walker, Samurai, UAV Ghost, and Sitrep to gain an edge over the competition.  Rounds are fast, weapon variety is huge, and every match rewards sharp aim and smart positioning over button-mashing. 
Crazy Strike Force plays entirely in your browser, so there's nothing to download or install — you can jump into a match on desktop in seconds.

title: FPS Strike
description:
About FPS Strike
FPS Strike is a free online shooter game created by FreezeNova, built for players who want a quick, no-hassle multiplayer FPS fix.  There's no lengthy install, no loadout customization screen to wade through — just press start and you're in the middle of the battlefield within seconds.  It offers both Free-for-All (FFA) and Team Deathmatch (TD) modes across five unique maps, backed by a arsenal of 18+ weapons ranging from precision pistols to one-shot sniper rifles. 
Playable free in your browser with no download required, FPS Strike combines realistic gunplay mechanics with fast, competitive matches in multiplayer rooms you can jump into anywhere, anytime.

title: Madalin Stunt Cars Pro
description:
About Madalin Stunt Cars Pro
Madalin Stunt Cars Pro is a free online 3D driving game that puts you behind the wheel of luxury supercars — Bugatti Veyron, Lamborghini Veneno, Pagani Zonda, LaFerrari, Ford GT, Huracan, Aventador, Ford Mustang Shelby Cobra GT, and more — along with a police cruiser you can flash through the streets in pursuit mode.  Three separate map areas give you different terrain to explore, each packed with ramps, loops, and open roads built for stunts rather than lap times.  There's no strict objective beyond picking a car, picking a map, and seeing what you can pull off. 
Madalin Stunt Cars Pro runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, and you can play it solo or create a multiplayer room to explore the same open maps alongside friends.

title: Escape Car 2
description:
About Escape Car 2
Escape Car 2 is a free online 3D police chase game you can play instantly in your browser, no download required.  Take the wheel of a stolen ride and tear through desert highways and city streets while an endless swarm of cop cars, armored trucks, and attack helicopters closes in behind you.  Grab cash scattered along the road, blast pursuers off your tail with rocket strikes, and work your way toward faster cars in the garage before the law finally catches up. 
A star meter tracks how far your wanted level has climbed, escalating the pursuit the longer you manage to stay loose.

title: Edys Car Simulator
description:
About Edys Car Simulator
Edys Car Simulator is a free online driving simulator that lets you freely roam an open city with a choice of five vehicles, including two sports cars, two pickup trucks, and a bus.  There's no set mission forcing you down a single path — you can cruise the streets for sightseeing, push a pickup truck through a dedicated off-road test track full of sandy hills and sharp drops, or use the game's load-testing system to haul a heavy stone around town. 
Edys Car Simulator runs directly in the browser with detailed vehicle physics, telemetry readouts, and even a slow-motion mode, so it's built for players who enjoy tinkering with realistic driving mechanics as much as casual cruising.  It plays free with no download required, and switching between vehicles and camera angles on the fly makes it easy to explore the city however you like.

title: Basket Hoop
description: In Basket Hoop, gravity is your only challenge, and tapping is your sole weapon.  Your goal is simple make the ball jump and send it inside the hoop.  The charm of the one button games peaks in Basket Hoop online.  Make as many baskets as you can in a limited amount of time.

title: Escape Car
description:
About Escape Car
Escape Car is a free online GTA-style game developed by FreezeNova Games that channels the top-down chaos of the very first Grand Theft Auto and rebuilds it with chunky 3D graphics, right in your browser.  You bolt through a mini-city, dodge police cars, tanks, and helicopters, and scoop up stacks of cash while the cops close in behind you.  Every tight drift, split-second fake-out, and totaled police cruiser bumps your score higher, and hanging on long enough leaves you with pockets full of upgrade money. 
Escape Car needs no download, install, or account to play, and its two-button steering scheme makes it instantly approachable even though the chase itself gets relentlessly harder the longer you survive.

title: Dublix
description:
Dublix is an online multiplayer game with its exciting Roblox-inspired World!  Wander in the maze to find the exit, take your part in the parkour and drive a car in the race-track to earn coins.  The best way to end the night is to dance freely at the music festival. 
Controls

WASD or Arrow Keys: Move
Spacebar: Jump
Left-Shift: Run
E Key: Interact

How to Play Dublix
Well, Dublix offers its players a free Roblox-inspired world.

title: Get On Top
description:
About Get On Top
Get On Top, developed by Neplin Game Studio in Construct 3, is a physics-based 2-player stickman wrestling game that turns childhood floor scuffles into a chaotic ragdoll brawl.  Two stickman fighters grapple, flip, and flail across the screen, each trying to pin the other by forcing their opponent's head into the ground while keeping their own head safely away from it.  The exaggerated ragdoll physics mean every match plays out differently, with limbs flying, momentum swings, and lucky recoveries that can turn a losing position into a win in an instant. 
You can play Get On Top for free directly in your browser, either against the built-in AI in 1 Player mode or head-to-head with a friend on the same keyboard in 2 Player mode, with mobile support through on-screen arrow buttons.

title: Police Chase Drifter
description:
About Police Chase Drifter
Police Chase Drifter is a free online driving game where you collect scattered cash across the city while a fleet of police cars tries to run you down.  Follow the on-screen arrows to track down money, then spend your earnings in the garage to buy and upgrade a faster, tougher ride — because outrunning the police gets harder the longer a chase drags on. 
Police Chase Drifter runs entirely in-browser with no download required, and its drift-focused driving model rewards players who can read a corner rather than just mash the accelerator.  Skillful drifting through tight turns often does the job for you — timed right, pursuing police cars crash into obstacles and take themselves out of the chase.

title: Draw The Bridge
description:
Draw The Bridge is a clever physics puzzle game where you must draw bridges, planks, and structures to guide a ball or character safely across gaps and obstacles.  Use your drawing skills and spatial logic to complete all 30 levels.  No download needed — play free in your browser. 

How to Play Draw The Bridge
Each level presents a gap that the ball or character cannot cross on its own.

title: WarStrike
description:
In the ocean of shoot-'em-all games, finding an online shooter that meets your console gamer expectations can feel impossible.  After playing legends like Counter-Strike or Far Cry, other online FPS games may seem bland, lacking an immersive story.  But believe it or not, WarStrike will give you the taste of playing Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, all from the comfort of your browser. 
WarStrike's campaign mode takes you deep into a critical mission as an elite MI-6 Special Soldier.

title: Velocity Rush
description:
About Velocity Rush
Velocity Rush is a free online arcade game published by FreezeNova where you guide a fast-moving golf ball through a gauntlet of obstacle courses.  Instead of putting the ball toward a hole, you're rolling it forward at high speed while dodging traps, gaps, spinning hazards, and narrow platforms that appear one after another.  The controls are simple — steer left and right, jump over hazards — but the pace ramps up quickly, so every course becomes a test of timing and reflexes rather than raw skill alone. 
Velocity Rush runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, and it works well on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Basketball io
description:
About Basketball io
Basketball io is a free online 3D basketball game built for anyone who wants slam-dunk action without a complicated control scheme.  You control a single player on a small-sided court, sprinting for the ball, dribbling past defenders, and finishing at the rim with flashy dunks.  Win matches to earn stars and diamonds, then spend them in the in-game shop to unlock new player skins ranging from NBA-style pros and cheerleaders to skeletons, monsters, and even basketball-playing bears, along with ten different balls including a rainbow ball and a fireball that you earn by completing in-game challenges like stealing the ball fifty times. 
Basketball io runs entirely in your browser on desktop and mobile, so there is nothing to download or install.

title: Checkout Frenzy
description: Have you ever stood in line at a store and wondered, “What exactly are the cashiers doing on that screen? ” All those bippity boppity beeps and flashing buttons...  What do they even mean?  Okay, we'll solve that mystery.

title: Cube Worlds
description: Remember those endless summer afternoons building castles and digging tunnels in Minecraft Classic?  Cube Worlds brings back that exact feeling, but even more casual.  It's the kind of block game you can fire up when you're between classes, stuck inside on a rainy day, or just in the mood to zone out and make something awesome.  There's no survival pressure, no mobs creeping up behind you.

title: Geometry Vector
description:
About Geometry Vector
Geometry Vector is a free online arcade game from FreezeNova where you guide a small arrow icon through fast-paced, rhythm-driven obstacle courses.  Your goal on every level is simple to state but hard to master: reach the portal at the end without touching a single spike or trap along the way.  As you move forward, coins scattered across the course let you unlock new arrow designs, giving you a visual reward for pushing further into the game's increasingly difficult levels. 
Playable free in your browser on desktop and mobile with no download required, Geometry Vector controls with a single input — click, tap, or hold — making it instantly accessible while still demanding precise, rhythm-based timing reminiscent of games like Geometry Dash.

title: Stickman Destruction
description:
About Stickman Destruction
Stickman Destruction is a free online ragdoll physics game where the goal is simple and satisfying: launch a stickman character down a ramp and rack up as much bone-breaking damage as possible.  You have 22 different map options, from Big Stairs to Free Slide, each offering a different layout of hurdles and drop points that change how the ragdoll collides and tumbles.  Earning points from your damage lets you unlock new maps, new jump poses, and a garage of 11 different vehicles, each changing how your stickman launches and crashes. 
Stickman Destruction runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and it includes a multiplayer mode where you can create or join a room to compete with other players over who can rack up the most destruction.

Some games are fun, some are clever, and then there's 2048, a perfect blend of both.  It's one of those rare gems that manages to be simple yet endlessly engaging.  Whether you're a numbers whiz or just love a good brain teaser, 2048 has something for everyone. 
A Bit of Math, A Bit of Luck
At first glance, 2048 might look like just another puzzle game, but spend a few minutes sliding those tiles, and you'll see why it's become a global sensation.

title: Hero Rush Tower Defense
description: Let's test how long you can withstand the attack waves.  Hero Rush Tower Defense is a 2D strategy game where your primary mission is to build and upgrade towers in order to defend your land.  Here, you will progress step by step and focus on a different map at each level.  Build your towers and protect your lands!

title: Legendary Sniper
description:
About Legendary Sniper
Legendary Sniper is a free online sniper shooting game developed by FreezeNova that puts you in the boots of the most talented marksman in your squad.  Following your commander's orders, you climb to rooftop vantage points across a series of levels and eliminate targets with precise headshots, managing a limited ammo supply while enemies move and take cover below.  As missions progress from beginner-friendly first levels to far messier later ones, you'll need sharper timing and better target discipline to keep completing objectives. 
The game runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and it's built around simple, intuitive mouse controls that make it approachable for casual players while still rewarding precision.

title: Drunken Duel
description: These two guys are wasted!  No wonder a minor conflict at the table about who will finish the bottle first, turned into a huge deal.  Even though these ragdolls are having problems standing up, they insist on making a duel.  Take some lessons from this incident, and never drink and duel in real life, folks!

title: Capybara Clicker Pro
description: Capybara Clicker Pro is an idle clicker game in which you tap on the adorable Capybara to collect Capybara coins.  Increase the number of coins you make by clicking on the cute animal every second and every click to achieve more significant figures!  The goal of this game is to tap and earn coins.  As you progress, you'll also be able to unlock new great characters!

title: Love Tester Story
description:
Find the One for You! 
Horoscopes, tarot cards, crystal balls, or dream readings—humans have been curious about the unknown since the dawn of time.  We have developed endless methods just to glimpse the future and act accordingly.  From interpreting patterns in tea leaves, coffee grounds, or wine sediments, cultures have found various ways to predict future events.

title: Burnout City
description: Burnout City is a place where the night never ends.  The streets of a hill-climbing city will be your playground.  Your toys?  Eleven awesome cars with lots of tuning options.

title: Backflip Challenge
description:
About Backflip Challenge
Backflip Challenge is a free online skill game developed by FreezeNova where you help an elastic-bodied grandpa launch off a trampoline and land a perfect backflip.  Your job is to time his jumps, spin him through a back tuck in mid-air, and bring him down feet-first on a red landing point painted on the ground below.  His bones are fragile, so a bad landing — too short, too long, or off-balance — ends the attempt.  With simple one-button controls and cartoonish graphics, Backflip Challenge turns a single physics-based trick into dozens of increasingly tricky levels.

title: Block Blast
description: Tetris is all fun and games, but the pressure of dropping blocks quickly?  Oh, it's not what we love in a chill puzzle game, right?  So, we've created Block Blast Online, offering endless Tetris fun without any time limits.  Take it easy, and place the blocks in the grids in peace.

title: Basketball King
description:
About Basketball King
Basketball King is a free online basketball game from FreezeNova that turns quick pickup ball into an over-the-top arcade showdown.  Instead of a simple shooting meter, you control a full player on the court — dribbling past defenders, timing pump fakes, stealing the ball, and slamming home dunks with flashy special moves.  The game supports Quick Match for fast one-off games, a Tournament mode where you climb through a full bracket of opponents, and a Local Multiplayer mode where two players can go head-to-head on the same keyboard.  It is built to be easy to learn but hard to master, with characters that each bring their own style and stats to the hardwood.

title: Wasteland Shooters
description:
About Wasteland Shooters
Wasteland Shooters is a free online multiplayer first-person shooter set across a ruined, post-apocalyptic world.  Build your own match by naming a room, setting the player limit, and choosing Free-For-All or Team mode, then drop onto one of four wasteland maps armed with one of nine weapons ranging from a close-range knife to a full rocket launcher. 
Wasteland Shooters runs entirely in-browser with no download required, and its room-based system lets you host a private match with friends or jump straight into a public game already in progress.  A full statistics screen tracks your games played, wins, kills, and score, so every match you finish adds to a record you can chase and improve.

title: 8 Ball Pool Billiard
description: Are you ready for your digital pool gaming experience?  8 Ball Pool Billiard is an online pool game where you can play with other players or against AI opponents.  The idea of ​​playing billiards against artificial intelligence sounds intriguing.  It can also be delightful to play billiards with online players.

title: Solitaire Adventure
description: Solitaire Adventure is a Tripeaks Solitaire game for everyone.  There are ten islands with tripeaks puzzles waiting to be solved.  Start with Bella's Island; she will guide you through this adventure.  Collect cards and clear all the boards.

title: Crazy Moto Racing
description: Crazy Moto Racing is an online 3D motorcycle racing game that puts your speed and skill to the test.  You might think that speed is your buddy here.  But let me assure you; control is your actual buddy.  You can enjoy competing against rivals or racing against time.

title: Highway Racer Pro
description:
For our community, who have played for hours and loved our Highway Traffic game, we know you've been asking us for an even more advanced version for some time.  And we're proud to say that we've delivered just that.  Ladies and Gentlemen, we are introducing Highway Racer Pro, the ultimate driving-in-traffic game, offering a great gameplay experience that's sure to satisfy even the most demanding drivers. 
As you drive through heavy traffic, you'll have the same opportunity to cut up cars and make your way to the top as you did before in other traffic games.

title: 99 Nights in the Forest
description:
About 99 Nights in the Forest
99 Nights in the Forest is a free online survival game developed by FreezeNova with a Roblox-like blocky art style.  You wake up alone in a deserted forest with one goal: survive 99 nights against the wilderness and the werewolves that hunt after dark.  Armed with just an axe at first, you'll chop wood, gather materials scattered across the forest, and craft weapons and tools to defend yourself, manage hunger, and stay warm by the light of a campfire once the sun goes down. 
99 Nights in the Forest runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, combining first-person survival mechanics with a light narrative thread.

title: Super Car Driving
description:
Super Car Driving is an online car game where you get to drive super-performing high-end models like Ferrari, Lamborghini, Porsche and more. 
This online driving game offers a full package with 3 game modes that can appeal to every taste.  Adrenaline seekers can enjoy completing stunt challenges while skill gamers maneuver their supercars in the lots of parking levels.  Meanwhile, free spirits can hit the road on a GTA ViceCity-like map and test their sports cars' performance.

title: Fall Brainrots
description:
About Fall Brainrots
Fall Brainrots, developed by FreezeNova, is a free online multiplayer parkour game that fuses Fall Guys-style battle royale obstacle courses with the internet's beloved Italian Brainrot meme characters.  You control a silly Brainrot avatar racing across obstacle-filled tracks, dodging hazards and platforms designed to knock you off, with the simple goal of reaching the finish line before the rest of the pack.  Falling off a course means elimination, so every jump and dash has to be timed with real precision, even while the game's absurd character designs keep the whole thing feeling lighthearted. 
The game runs entirely in your browser on desktop with no download required, using WASD or arrow keys for movement, a mouse-controlled camera, and a spacebar jump.

title: Crazy Drifter
description:
About Crazy Drifter
Crazy Drifter is a free online racing simulator built entirely around sliding sideways through corners rather than taking the fastest straight line.  It offers four distinct racing modes — Drift, Time Attack, Knockout, and Circuit — each giving you a different way to test your car control against the clock or against other racers.  Between races, you can spend your earnings in the garage to buy new cars or heavily customize your current one, from paint and body kits down to the exhaust. 
Crazy Drifter runs directly in your browser with no download required, and plays smoothly with a keyboard on desktop.

title: Car Football
description: Are you ready to breathe new life into football?  Car Football is a 2 player car game where you can kick a goal to the opponent's side with your favorite monster truck.  There are 6 cars listed for you, two available in the first place.  To open the rest, you need to earn coins via the games you have played.

title: Golf Bit
description:
About Golf Bit
Golf Bit is a free online golf game developed by FreezeNova that strips golf down to its most satisfying moment: the swing.  Instead of managing a full course with clubs and par, you take aim, watch a moving indicator sweep across a power meter, and hit the ball when the indicator lines up with the middle of the green zone for the cleanest, longest shot.  Sinking the ball into holes on the course earns you rewards and levels you up, and coins collected from successful shots let you unlock entirely new courses to play on, including alien planets far beyond a standard fairway. 
Golf Bit runs directly in your browser with no download or installation needed, and it's fully playable on mobile with simple tap controls.

title: Nuts and Bolts Puzzle
description: Ever gotten lost in a maze of planks and screws when trying to build an IKEA shelf?  Well, Nuts and Bolts Puzzle is like the opposite of that!  Instead of frantically trying to assemble stuff, you’re gleefully taking everything apart and the best part is: no confusing instructions required.  In this fun online game on OnlineGames.

title: Geometry Dash FreezeNova
description:
Give yourself over to the beat of the song!  Discover the FreezeNova difference while playing the well-known arcade game Geometry Dash.  In Geometry Dash FreezeNova, the challenging arcade game, your goal is to keep the cube clear of every obstacle on the flowing surface.  
Like with the original Geometry Dash, playing this game is most enjoyable when you give in to the music's beat.

title: ArmedForces.io
description: Prepare for epic battles!  ArmedForces. io is a 3D action game where you will combat enemy forces on various game maps with multiple game mode choices.  Arrange your loadouts from eight unique weapons at your disposal.

title: Mini Cars Racing
description: Mini Cars Racing is a 2 player car racing game you can play free on OnlineGames. io!  You can race against the clock or battle a friend on the same device.  It's fast, fun, and feels just like playing with toy cars on your childhood road traffic rug.

title: Drift Rider
description:
Drift Rider is a 3D drift game where the players can customize their vehicle and then hit the road.  There are 5 distinct racetracks that the player can drift on.  You may drive on a highway or in the streets of a city. 
Or, take the task of navigating a curving and narrow intercity route by drifting.

title: Stick Guys Defense
description:
About Stick Guys Defense
Stick Guys Defense is a free online 3D tower defense game where you command an army of stickman soldiers to protect your castle from a never-ending invasion.  Waves of evil creatures attack from all directions, and your job is to hold the line for as long as possible using front-row sword units and back-row archers.  There's no final wave to survive to — the invasion keeps coming, so your real goal is to upgrade smart and last as long as you can before 20 enemies manage to break through into your castle. 
Stick Guys Defense runs entirely in your browser on desktop and mobile with no download or install required.

title: Secret Sniper Agent
description:
You have been given a special mission: to eliminate the men in suits!  Secret Sniper Agent is a 2D shooting game in which you are a skilled sniper agent.  You have a crucial task on the rooftop. 
You must hunt down all the men with silenced guns who are moving left and right in the city park.

title: Alien Sky Invasion
description: Alien Sky Invasion is an aircraft driving game where you steer a jet aircraft in the infinite void of Space.  But you will not be alone in the sky.  Aliens from different galactic races will accompany you, but not in a good way.  They will try to attack your jet and shoot lasers.

title: Chess FreezeNova
description:
About Chess FreezeNova
Chess FreezeNova is a free online chess game developed by FreezeNova that lets you play a full match against the computer AI, a friend on the same device, or opponents from around the world.  Whether you're just learning the rules or you're a seasoned competitive player, the game gives you full control over the experience: adjust the time limit, pick a difficulty level, choose to play as white or black, and even customize the board and piece colors to your liking. 
Chess FreezeNova runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, playable on both desktop and mobile.  Beyond standard matches, it includes a dedicated Puzzles section for sharpening your tactics, an offline pass-and-play mode for when you don't have a physical board handy, and a Vs Friend mode for private matches with people you know.

title: Cake Match Puzzle
description: Cake Match Puzzle is an addictive free game where you become a bakery chef.  You’ll play with cake slices on a 4x4 tray, merging them to create full cakes.  The goal is simple: make as many cakes as possible before you run out of moves.  It’s all about strategy, smart placement, and a little bit of luck!

title: Nova Billiard
description:
About Nova Billiard
Nova Billiard is a free online pool game where precise aim with a cue stick is everything, much like lining up a shot in a shooting game.  You can play against a computer opponent for quick practice or find yourself an online opponent for a real competitive match, choosing your username before jumping into a game.  The game also includes a dedicated Training section in the menu, letting you run trial games and get comfortable with your aim before stepping into a full match. 
Nova Billiard runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, and it offers both 2D and 3D viewing modes so you can play the way that feels most natural to you.

title: Crazy Cattle 3D
description: Crazy Cattle 3D is a one-player battle royale game where you control a bouncy sheep and try to knock other sheep in the herd.  The physics are strange.  And the movement of other sheep is absolute comedy.  With a third-person perspective, you'll try to be the last sheep standing in the herd, all while the sheep slides and bounces uncontrollably.

title: Mob City
description: Are you confident enough to attack the mafia gang alone?  Mob City is a 3D shooting game with many missions to complete.  You have a tremendous responsibility.  Because it is up to you to defeat the bad guys.

title: Crazy Parking Fury
description: Imagine yourself driving in a coastal city with summer music in the air.  You have only one thing to worry about in this heaven: cops!  Crazy Parking Fury is a 3D parking game where you run away from cops and park cars in dedicated spots.  In this GTA-like game, you can also steal parked cars if you are good at avoiding the police.

With over 200 million copies sold, Minecraft is one of the most successful games ever.  This proves that sandbox creativity is here to stay.

title: Pixelmon Town
description:
Pixelmon Town is an online sandbox game inspired by Minecraft.  With your unlimited material options, you are invited to create your own world and build whatever you desire, whether it is a castle or a warm home! 
Dig, carve and build structures with various blocks ranging from stone to gold.  Choose Flatgrass or Vanilla maps, then start breaking blocks and building your dreamy world!

title: Head Soccer 2022
description: Head Soccer 2022 is a 2D sports game in which you engage in football matches with a friend or against the CPU.  The first thing to do is choose your beloved football player.  You will take part in matches in his shoes!  Be the one who scores the most and get your World Cup in this thrilling arcade game!

title: Taxi Simulator
description: Welcome to New York City!  Being a taxi driver in a metropolitan city… Sounds challenging.  Taxi Simulator is a driving game where you pick up your customers from a specific place and get them to their desired destination as soon as possible.  It is a very addictive game, as its graphics and vivid traffic offer a real-time gaming experience.

title: Fast Food Manager
description:
About Fast Food Manager
Fast Food Manager, developed by FreezeNova, is a free online tycoon and simulator game that puts you in charge of your very own fast food restaurant.  You start small, greeting customers with a warm smile and serving up hamburgers, before gradually expanding your menu to include Italian pizzas and French fries as your income grows.  The core challenge is simple to grasp but genuinely engaging: keep your customers happy and served quickly, because a long wait means a lost sale and a missed tip. 
Fast Food Manager runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, controlled with nothing more than a mouse, which makes it an easy pick-up-and-play tycoon game on both desktop and mobile.

title: Rooftop Duel
description: Can you handle a rooftop shoot-out with gravity, ragdoll limbs, and a toybox of overpowered weapons?  The recoil is wild here.  Rooftop Duel piles all the goofy physics of classic ragdoll games.  You'll try to knock off your opponent on a city rooftop.

title: Stunt Rider
description: Are you fond of driving the best cars in the world and performing backflips?  Stunt Rider is a 3D driving game where your main aim is to jump from sky-high ramps.  Get on the pedal and move quickly towards platforms.  Turn your car entirely by maneuvering left or right while in the air.

title: Geometry Escape
description:
About Geometry Escape
Geometry Escape is a free online platformer for players who enjoy fast-paced, skill-based challenges in the style of Geometry Dash.  Developed by FreezeNova, it puts you in control of a cube that moves forward automatically at a set speed while you handle every jump and flight needed to survive an obstacle course built from spikes, pits, chainsaws, and gravity-flipping sections.  There are no checkpoints, which means every level is a genuine test of memory and reflexes — a single mistimed jump sends you back to the start, so learning the rhythm of each course is just as important as raw reaction speed. 
Geometry Escape runs entirely in your browser on both desktop and mobile with no download required, using a single tap-or-click input that keeps the controls simple even as the level design gets brutally demanding.

title: Supercars Drift
description: Supercars Drift is a drift game where you level up by performing drifts.  You will level up and unlock new sports cars every time you break a specific record.  You have ten unique car options in this thrilling car game.  Unlock each one to enjoy a different gaming experience.

title: F1 Drift Racer
description:
About F1 Drift Racer
F1 Drift Racer is a free online 2D drift racing game where you compete against 4 other Formula 1 racers across curved tracks, completing 2 laps per race to claim first place.  You start with a classic F1 vehicle and unlock new models and colors as you earn money from races, with 20 increasingly intricate levels testing how well you can carry speed through drift points without losing control.  A Multiplayer option also lets you set up a room and race directly against other real players. 
F1 Drift Racer runs entirely in your browser with no download required, playable on desktop with keyboard controls.

title: Tractor Farming Simulator
description:
Tractor Farming Simulator is a farming game where you are responsible for agricultural work.  You need to complete many farming tasks step by step.  You must cultivate the field, sow the seeds and water the land.  
Get in your tractor, gather your farm machines, and head to your land in this virtual agricultural world in one of the most realistic farming games!

title: Sniper Elite
description:
About Sniper Elite
Sniper Elite puts you in the role of a precision marksman on a mission to eliminate high-value targets from long range.  Zoom in on your target, account for distance and movement, and squeeze the trigger only when you have a clear shot.  Each mission places you in a different environment with specific targets to eliminate, with enemy patrols adding pressure throughout. 
Sniper Elite runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and supports touch controls on mobile browsers for iOS and Android.

title: Airplane Racer
description: Fly through the arcades with Airplane Racer!  Airplane Racer is a vivid plane game you can play solo or with a friend.  While solo mode makes you wander the sky alone, versus mode enables you to race with a friend.  In this game, you have many options, like game modes, track options, and airplane alternatives.

title: State io Wars
description: Give commands to your mini soldiers and try to get new lands!  State io Wars is a 2D war game where your objective is to conquer lands as much as possible.  To do that, send your troops to a neutral or your opponent's area and take it.  By directing your army wisely, you can achieve victory in this strategy game!

title: Solitaire
description: "Emma's afternoon hit a wall at exactly 3:17 PM.  Her inbox chimed again, another urgent task from her manager.  Minimized the spreadsheet and opened Solitaire on OnlineGames. io.

title: Urban Sniper
description:
About Urban Sniper
Urban Sniper is a 3D shooting game that puts you in the boots of a rooftop marksman hired to clean up a city overrun by thieves, snatchers, terrorists, and mafia lords.  Each of the 21 levels hands you a new target list, and your job is to line up the shot and take the criminal down before they escape the scene.  Civilians wander the same streets, though, and hitting one ends your duty immediately, so patience and a steady aim matter more than speed. 
Coins earned from clean kills let you buy better rifles as you climb through the levels, and the difficulty ramps up steadily from easy warm-up missions to genuinely tense standoffs against career criminals.

title: Fort Drifter
description: Fort Drifter is a drift game where you can steer crazy cars on a platform full of jumping ramps, highway roads in different shapes, and castles.  You will love the game's impressive graphics, reminding you of the Fortnite Drift.  The game allows you to build tracks on the platform as you wish.  It means that you can create your ramps and roads and drive on them in this splendid car game!

title: Moto Trials
description:
About Moto Trials
Moto Trials is a free online 3D driving game where you ride a motorcycle across a platform packed with ramps and obstacles, testing your bike control and reflexes level after level.  You start with a standard red sports motorcycle and can unlock two more bikes as you clear levels and earn in-game money.  Each new level pushes the platform further and adds tighter turns, sudden drops, and moving obstacles that force you to react fast and keep your balance. 
Moto Trials runs directly in your browser on desktop and mobile with no download required, so you can jump straight into the action.

title: Julie Beauty Salon
description:
About Julie Beauty Salon
Julie Beauty Salon is a free online makeover game where you step into the role of a professional beauty expert running your own salon.  Developed by FreezeNova Games, the game hands you three fabulous clients who each need a full glam transformation across three stations: makeup, hair styling, and manicure.  You pick lipstick shades, blend blush, choose eyelashes, cut and recolor hair (even mixing two-tone looks like pink and blue), and finish with polish, glitter, nail art, and jewelry.  Every choice is yours, so you can go for soft natural glam or bold, dramatic looks depending on your mood.

title: Rome Simulator
description: How often do you think about the Roman Empire?  The answer is every day for most men.  It is interesting that such a historic figure lingers in our minds after centuries.  While we leave this analysis to the experts, we're excited to present a great game for Roman Empire enthusiasts.

title: Stunt Simulator 2
description:
Are you ready to perform stunts with any car you can think of?  Jump in the driver's seat, and we're going!  Stunt Simulator 2 is a 3D driving game that provides free access to many kinds of cars. 
Choose the car you favor most and set for the road to perform stunts.

title: 2 Player Crazy Racer
description:
About 2 Player Crazy Racer
2 Player Crazy Racer is a free online 3D racing game set on the streets of a retro Long Island in the 1960s, built specifically for two players sharing a single keyboard.  You and a friend each pick a classic car — vehicles like the Ford 1934 Model 40 V8, Cadillac Series 61, Tucker Torpedo 1948, Mercedes Benz 540 K, Ford 1946 Coupe, or Ford 1932 — then race side by side to collect coins and unlock more vintage rides.  The retro visuals and car selection give the whole game a period feel that will remind seasoned gamers of titles like L. A.

title: Four Colors
description:
Four Colors is a famous card game that brings fun to all ages.  If you would like to play a game like UNO and have some fun in your free time, come grab your cards and prepare yourself for a win.  
How to Play Four Colors? 
Four Colors is inspired by the popular card game UNO.

title: Basketball Slam Dunk
description:
About Basketball Slam Dunk
Basketball Slam Dunk is a free online 2D basketball game with a retro pixel-art style, playable either against the computer or head-to-head against a friend in local 2 player mode.  Rather than simple free throws, matches revolve around grabbing the ball from your opponent's hands and rushing toward their hoop for a dunk, with arms flying and tangling as both players scramble for possession.  The first player to score 3 dunks wins, keeping matches short, fast-paced, and easy to jump back into for a rematch. 
The game runs entirely in your browser with no download required and works well on Chromebooks as well as standard desktop browsers.

title: Burnout Drift Hunter
description: Burnout Drift Hunter is a free online game you can play in your browser through onlinegames. io.  The game is filled with adrenaline and offers hours of furious driving for players of all skill levels.  Give it a try and unleash your inner drift master!

title: Police Traffic
description:
About Police Traffic
Police Traffic is a free online 3D driving game that puts you behind the wheel of a police car weaving through heavy highway traffic.  Other vehicles speed up, slow down, and stop suddenly without warning, so surviving means mastering tight overtakes, quick lane changes, and split-second braking while collecting money along the road.  Before each run you choose from a roster of police vehicles, each with its own balance of speed, handling, and braking power, so picking the right car for the mode you're playing matters as much as your driving skill. 
Police Traffic runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, and its four distinct game modes give the traffic-dodging formula real variety.

title: Crazy Ball Adventures
description:
About Crazy Ball Adventures
Crazy Ball Adventures is a free online 3D arcade game from FreezeNova where you steer a ball along narrow parkour tracks suspended high above an endless sea.  Much like the popular game Slope, careful, steady control matters far more than speed: your job across 30 challenging levels is to guide the ball to the finish line while dodging gaps, sharp bends, mines, and huge moving walls, all without tumbling off the edge into the water below.  Along the way, collect three stars scattered on each track to fully clear a level rather than simply surviving it. 
The game runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, and it plays smoothly with keyboard controls on desktop.

title: Troll Level
description: Okay, you asked for it!  Playing Troll Level Online will be a humbling experience because this is the troll game ever.  Get ready to feel like a complete failure while bursting into laughter!  Not every game offers that kind of combo, right?

title: Deer Hunter
description: Deer Hunter is a 2D shooting game where you play as a skilled deer huntsman.  Using your sniper skills, you must shoot all the deer on the grass field.  You must aim well and make precise shootings as you have a few ammo.  As you level up, the number of deer will increase.

title: Bandits Multiplayer PvP
description:
About Bandits Multiplayer PvP
Bandits Multiplayer PvP is a free online 3D action game set in a lawless Wild West where every cowboy is fighting for survival.  You ride into battle on a loyal warhorse — the only ally you can trust — using arrows for ranged attacks and a sword for close combat against other bandits or waves of zombies, depending on the mode.  With six distinct game modes and three different maps, matches range from chaotic free-for-alls to focused team fights and zombie survival runs. 
Playable free in your browser with no download required, Bandits Multiplayer PvP runs on desktop with full WASD-and-mouse controls.

title: Kick The Dummy
description: Sometimes, the stress of daily life overwhelms you, and you feel like punching the wall.  All you need at that moment is to release that stress.  There is just something for you here!  Kick The Dummy is an action game where you punch, shoot, bomb and crash the robotic victim.

title: Survival Karts
description: Looking for the coolest, most chaotic online racing game?  Play Survival Karts on OnlineGames. io!  It's a survival showdown on an icy, hole-riddled track!

title: Highway Cars
description: Highway Cars is a 3D driving game where you steer your car on the highway in the flow of traffic.  The key point here is dodging the other cars without any accident.  The more cars you dodge, the more points you get.  Passing the cars as close as possible will be an adrenaline-pumping challenge in this car game, which is inspired by the popular game Highway Traffic!

title: Archer Hero
description: In Archer Hero, we give you the possibility to enter the world of mysticism and magic.  Begin the journey by testing your archery abilities and eliminating potential enemies.  You can select from a variety of bows, arrows, and targets in order to improve your shooting skills.  Every level brings new challenges and rewards.

title: Cookie Clicker Pro
description: Love cookies?  Want to create the biggest cookie empire the internet has ever seen?  Then Cookie Clicker Pro is exactly your game!  It's a simple, addictively fun incremental game, packed with sweet strategies.

title: Super Mini Racing
description:
About Super Mini Racing
Super Mini Racing is a free online 3D racing game from developer FreezeNova that lets you race tiny, exaggerated cars across 10 unique tracks, either solo against bots or head-to-head with a friend in split-screen mode.  Pick your difficulty — easy, medium, or hard — then race through 10 challenging levels, pulling off drifts and airtime along the way to boost your earnings on top of the coins you win from finishing races. 
Super Mini Racing runs directly in your browser on OnlineGames. io with no download or install required, and both single-player and 2-player modes work smoothly on desktop.

title: Snake Football
description: Slide your snake and score a goal!  Snake Football is a 2D soccer game in which you direct a snake on a football field.  Your cute animal is a footballer!  Your main objective is to score as many goals as possible within 2 minutes.

title: Princess Influencer Salon
description: We are dedicating today entirely to skincare and fashion!  Princess Influencer Salon is a 2D girl game where you help a princess make her skincare and get her dressed up for a night event or a stay out.  You are the expert in this field.  That's why she can safely leave herself in your arms.

title: Fire and Water
description: Fire and Water is a challenging two-player game where you and your mate try to overcome all the obstacles in a temple, as in the most popular web browser game of the 2000s: Fireboy and Watergirl.  It draws inspiration from the beloved game.  Play as Fire and Water and collect all the stars in the game.  For the gamers who finished all the versions of the original Fireboy and Watergirl game series and still hungry for further levels Fire and Water is your cup of tea.

title: Motorbike Traffic
description: Are you ready for a motorcycle tour on the highway?  It is time to glide between the cars with your motorcycle in the flowing traffic.  Motorbike Traffic is a racing game where you collect points by blowing off someone's vehicle's doors.  Pass cars, collect coins and unlock the new police motorbike.

title: Crazy Karts
description:
About Crazy Karts
Crazy Karts is a free online multiplayer racing game from FreezeNova that brings the thrill of go-kart racing into the browser, minus the real-world safety risks.  Many Formula 1 drivers started their careers in karting, and Crazy Karts channels that same speed and chaos into weapon-based combat racing — you drive small, lightweight karts through arenas, collect gift boxes for weapons, and smash your way past other players to be the last kart standing.  It's part race, part battle arena, playable solo against bots or online against real opponents. 
Crazy Karts runs entirely in the browser with no download or installation required, making it easy to jump into a private or public room from any desktop device.

title: Ultimate Moto
description:
Does gaming feel overwhelming lately?  Big-budget titles flood us with complex controls, hundreds of features, and graphics so detailed they're exhausting to follow.  Sometimes you end up feeling stressed just trying to keep up instead of feeling relaxed. 
In all that noise, what many of us truly crave is the simplicity of arcade mechanics.

title: FNF Funk 3D
description:
About FNF Funk 3D
FNF Funk 3D is a free online rhythm arcade game where you go head-to-head against a music-loving rival in a series of funk dance battles.  Arrow symbols scroll across the screen in time with the beat, and you have to hit the matching key exactly when each arrow reaches the target zone.  Land your notes cleanly and the red-and-green progress bar at the top of the screen tilts in your favor; miss too many and your rival takes the lead. 
FNF Funk 3D runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, and works on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Nova Clicker
description: Nova Clicker is an online idle game which starts you off with a single, smiley Nova, its name is FreezeNova.  A simple tap or click on FreezeNova produces your first handful of stars.  But don't be fooled, this clicker game quickly grows beyond basic tapping.  Soon, you'll be managing an entire universe of quirky characters and powerful upgrades, all designed to make you the ultimate star tycoon.

title: Hero Dragon Power
description:
About Hero Dragon Power
Hero Dragon Power is a side-scrolling brawler that sends you through 20 levels of fierce enemies, mixing heavy punches, special abilities, and agile movement to fight your way forward.  You pick from a roster of characters before each run, and every one of them can be upgraded over time, with damage and critical hit chance climbing toward a maximum of five stars as you invest in them. 
With only three lives to work with, the game rewards balancing speed and power rather than button-mashing through every fight.  Watching your character's health alongside their strength stats is part of the challenge, since a reckless push through a tough level can end your run early.

title: Masked Forces Zombie Survival
description:
About Masked Forces Zombie Survival
Masked Forces Zombie Survival is a free online first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by the undead.  You take up arms, team up with a squad, and hold the line against relentless waves of zombies pouring in from every direction.  The game gives you a full arsenal to work with, including revolvers, sniper rifles, HMGs, and grenades, plus a range of armor sets like watchdog armor, supreme armor, death masks, and doom squad masks, all of which can be purchased and upgraded as you climb through unlocked levels. 
Masked Forces Zombie Survival runs directly in your browser with no download required, and it can be played either online or offline.

title: Among Impostor
description: Among Impostor is an exciting web browser game inspired by the popular multiplayer deception game Among Us.  In this thrilling experience, you will be part of a crew.  All the crewmates are busy diligently completing their tasks.  But here is the twist: someone is there to kick it up a notch.

title: Tank Arena
description: Tank Arena is an online tank battle game that you can play with your friend on the same device.  In a 2D maze, each tank’s shot can bounce off walls, so you never know where danger might appear next.  Similar to the famous browser game Tank Trouble, this game ups the challenge by letting you take on AI tanks, go head-to-head with a friend, or try intense online matches.  Now load Tank Arena and sneak in a quick battle when you’ve got some free time!

title: Find It
description: Looking for a cozy, sweet and oh-so adorable feel-good game?   Then Find It is the perfect game to play.  It's like wrapping yourself in a warm, fuzzy blanket but for your brain!  You start off in a kid's room, but it's not just any room.

title: Crazy Car Arena
description:
About Crazy Car Arena
Crazy Car Arena is a free online 3D stunt-driving game from FreezeNova that drops you into an obstacle-packed arena full of tight turns, inversions, steep ramps, and blazing fire rings.  Pick a car, hit the gas, and chase the highest score by chaining drifts, jumps, and stunts while an aggressive AI driver chases you down and tries to crash your run.  Beyond the stunt track, Crazy Car Arena also hides a stadium mode where you push a giant ball into your opponent's goal using nothing but your car, turning the same wild driving skills into a car-soccer showdown. 
Crazy Car Arena runs entirely in the browser with no download or installation needed, and it works on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Drako IO
description:
About Drako IO
Drako IO is a free online multiplayer fantasy arena game playable directly in your browser with no download required.  Built in the style of a MOBA, it puts you in command of a team of three heroes as you battle real opponents across a structured arena map featuring towers, lanes, and contested objectives.  With a roster of six distinct champions, a deep equipment system, and multiple game modes including Battle, Conquest, and Arena, Drako IO offers the kind of progression and replayability that keeps players coming back. 
The game is powered by FreezeNova.

title: Nova Craft
description: We're taking you back a billion years to the dawn of creation.  Armed with only four basic elements—fire, water, earth, and air.  You'll start the Big Bang from scratch.  In this alchemy game, combine elements to create new ones and see history unfold.

title: Monster Survivors
description: Monster Survivors is an free online survival game with a minimalistic design and roguelite elements.  The monsters are here, and you must survive!   Aggressive crabs, eerie pumpkins, flesh-eating plants and yes, even evil bees!   But on a vast open land, there's no place to run or hide.

title: Drift Fury
description: Drift Fury is a 3D drift game where you participate in drift challenges and races with the most exotic sports cars.  You will enjoy driving your car near the pine trees and mountain views.  Get in the driver's seat and start the engine.  The winding road calls you to make the dust fly in one of the most enjoyable driving games!

title: Battle Royale Simulator
description: Battle Royale Simulator is a 3D shooting game where you land on the field with a parachute and face enemies.  Your enemies are ready to attack you the moment they see you.  You must be cautious while moving, as anyone could be behind you.  Pick up your gun from the ground and eliminate the masked enemies in this battle game!

title: Highway Moto
description:
About Highway Moto
Highway Moto is a free online racing game from FreezeNova where you weave a powerful motorbike through dense highway traffic at high speed.  Dodging cars, buses, and trucks, splitting between lanes, and pulling off sharp maneuvers are all part of surviving the ride, with 3 game modes and 4 unlockable bikes giving you different ways to test your riding skills.  Built with realistic 3D graphics in Unity, the game captures the feel of a courier or delivery rider racing against time and traffic, where a single careless mistake can end your run instantly. 
Highway Moto runs entirely in the browser with no download or installation required, and it's playable on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Zombie Sniper
description: Get ready for zombie hunting!  We will go on a long journey.  Zombie Sniper is a 2D shooting game where you are trying to shoot the zombies in the head.  Take your place on the roof.

title: Pyramid Solitaire
description: Pyramid Solitaire is a free online card game at OnlineGames. io.  In this calming card puzzle, you need to remove a pyramid of cards by selecting pairs that add up to 13.  It's a simple but fun game to learn.

title: American Touchdown
description:
About American Touchdown
American Touchdown is a free online ball game where two ragdoll-style players fight for possession of a football and race to carry it into the opponent's end zone.  Your character's arms swing and legs jump automatically, so the real skill lies in positioning yourself to grab the ball out of your rival's hands and shielding it once you have possession.  It plays out like a chaotic, physics-driven scramble rather than a traditional football sim, which makes every match feel unpredictable and funny. 
American Touchdown runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and it supports both a 1 Player mode against the computer and a same-screen 2 Player mode for head-to-head matches with a friend.

title: Car Wash
description: Washing your car will become enjoyable with Car Wash!  Car Wash is a car maintenance simulator you can play for free on OnlineGames. io.  There are many cars available to you.

title: Perfect First Date
description: Perfect First Date is one of the best dress up game for girls, where they, as fashion gurus, help the girls get ready for their first date!  This is a big day.  Because they will meet "the" lover candidate for the first time.  And the first impression always matters.

title: Tank Racing
description:
About Tank Racing
Tank Racing is a free online 2D driving game where you steer a tank across bumpy, hilly terrain in a military-themed area, racing through 30 levels of increasingly rough roads.  Sharp ups and downs line every track, and collecting coins along the way lets you unlock new tanks to change up your ride.  Beyond the single-player campaign, Tank Racing also supports online multiplayer, letting you race directly against three other players in a shared room once everyone is ready. 
Tank Racing runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, and it's built around simple, physics-driven controls that stay easy to pick up even as the terrain gets tougher.

title: Crazy Stickman Physics
description:
Find the perfect position and make your stickman jump!  Crazy Stickman Physics is a 2D stickman game where your utmost challenge is to break as many bones as you can.  Earn coins as you break your stickman's bones. 
Use your money to unlock new settings and purchase vehicles and outfits for your ragdoll.

title: Jungle Mart
description:
About Jungle Mart
Jungle Mart is a free online tycoon and simulator game developed by FreezeNova where you play as a farmer monkey running a banana farm and store.  You grow banana trees, harvest the fruit once it ripens, and stock it on shelves so customers can buy it, using your earnings to unlock new fields and expand into corn, chickens for eggs, and cows for milk.  As your business grows, you can hire monkey employees to help with the workload and add machines like a microwave for popcorn and a yogurt machine to sell even more products. 
Jungle Mart runs entirely in your browser with no download required, playable on both desktop and mobile with simple drag-and-move controls.

title: Snake
description: Slither your way through a maze with Snake Online.  Your mission is to eat all the apples you can find without biting your own tail.  As this sneaky snake grows, so does the challenge.  Each apple makes it longer and you smarter!

title: Mad Doctor
description: Does beating up an angry virtual doctor make you feel better?  Release the dark humor in you with the crazy hospital game.  Mad Doctor is a crazy game where you try to mess with a virtual crazy doctor by using types of weapons, scalpels, and some medical chemicals.  You can make the doctor even madder with anything that can be found in a hospital.

title: Dark Ninja Hanjo
description: The city was destroyed.  Dark Ninja Hanjo is an adventure game where you explore and try to recover this ruined city.  But it will take a lot of work.  You need to recover the ancient scroll first to be able to make it happen.

title: Neon Racer
description: About Neon RacerNeon Racer is a free online bike racing game that combines high-speed action with a striking neon visual style.  You ride through 30 progressively challenging levels, weaving around obstacles, collecting diamonds, and keeping your bike upright on tracks that demand constant focus.  The glowing, futuristic aesthetics make every run feel intense, while the straightforward controls keep the game accessible whether you are new to bike racers or a seasoned player looking for a quick adrenaline hit. Speed management is at the heart of Neon Racer.

title: Trains io
description: Welcome to Trains io!  Trains. io is a fun and exciting free online game where you and other players are little toy trains.  The goal is to increase the number of carriages as many as possible.

title: Cool Brainrot Clicker
description:
About Cool Brainrot Clicker
Cool Brainrot Clicker is a free online idle clicker game built around the internet's favorite absurd brainrot characters, giving you a chill and silly way to rack up an ever-growing score.  The core idea is simple — click or tap to earn coins — but the game layers in power-ups you can buy and sell, along with unlockable brainrot characters that automatically generate extra coins with every click, turning a basic clicker into a small strategy loop of upgrading, unlocking, and rebuilding your setup. 
Cool Brainrot Clicker runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, and your progress saves automatically, so you can close the tab and pick up exactly where you left off.  It's free to play from start to finish, with every upgrade purchased using the coins you earn simply by clicking, making it an easy, low-pressure game to leave running in a spare tab while you rack up your score.

title: Farming Island
description:
If you’ve ever zoned out at work, dreaming about quitting everything and running your own farm on a sunny island… yeah, same.  Farming Island lets you do just that, without ever leaving the city or even your browser.  Farming Island Online is a relaxed, clicker-style farming game where you explore a peaceful island, plant crops, raise animals, fish a little, and stack up some digital coins. 
You start off with a nice little plot of land, a few thousand coins in your pocket, and no clue what you’re doing, but that’s part of the fun.

title: Survival Craft
description:
Survival Craft is a sandbox game where the player crafts tools such as an axe and a shovel, weapons and even wearables in order to survive in the jungle.  Gather the necessary materials to craft any item. 
Do not forget to construct buildings for yourself to take shelter.  Create an environment for yourself where you can survive under the harsh conditions of raw nature!

title: Pixel Driver
description:
About Pixel Driver
Pixel Driver is a free online driving game, developed by FreezeNova, built for players who just want a simple pixel car and a colorful blocky city to roam.  You hop into a pixel-style car and explore streets shared with AI-controlled police cars, fire trucks, and ambulances, all of which keep the city feeling busy and alive.  The game blends old-school pixel graphics with modern 3D visuals, giving it a nostalgic look without sacrificing smooth, modern movement. 
Pixel Driver runs entirely in your browser with no download required, playable on desktop with keyboard controls.

title: Global Guesser
description: Global Guesser Online is a fun and exciting way to test your geographical knowledge and curiosity.  This free geography guessing game on OnlineGames. io literally drops you into random spots around the world.  Think busy city squares all around the globe, Wall Street, the Eiffel Tower, the Taj Mahal or a remote desert in the Middle East, or perhaps quiet mountain towns in the Far East.

title: Tiny Crash Fighters
description: Tiny Crash Fighters is an action game where your most significant task is to build your robot to destroy the CPU's and other players' machines.  Pick your vehicle, embody it with weapons and go to the battling arena.  The robots will fight automatically.  All you have to do is to create your mighty vehicle in this destroying game!

title: Kingdom Battle 3D
description: If you're into free games that mix brainpower strategy with epic battle scenes, Kingdom Battle 3D might be your next obsession.  This isn’t just another button-masher.  You’re the commander here, calling the shots, building your army, and leading your troops into some seriously intense medieval battles.  Knights, mages, cavalry, and magic spells flying everywhere.

title: Blocky Parkour Ninja
description:
About Blocky Parkour Ninja
Blocky Parkour Ninja is a free online first-person parkour game set in a pixelated, Minecraft-style world where a lone ninja must leap between floating blocks without falling into the deadly water below.  Across 60 levels of escalating difficulty, each with its own layout and scenario, you're racing a stopwatch as much as you're navigating the course — every second counts, and the slightest miscalculated jump sends your ninja plunging into the water below, forcing a restart. 
Blocky Parkour Ninja runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, rendered in vivid, blocky graphics with smooth first-person movement.  The controls are simple enough to pick up immediately, but the combination of a first-person view, precise jump timing, and a ticking clock makes even early levels demand real focus, while the full 60-level run tests reflexes and quick decision-making all the way through.

title: Kings io
description: The road to royalty is that way!  ⬆️ If you're ready to rule your own kingdom, play Kings io.  This is an exciting online strategy game where you start as a small-time ruler, determined to rise to glory by building a grand empire.  If you’re up for gathering gold, recruiting strong troops, and outsmarting enemy kings, then this free game is your perfect battlefield.

title: Racing Cars
description: Racing Cars is a 2D racing game where you engage in thrilling races with professional racers.  You and your opponents will race on a bumpy road with many obstacles.  There are many ups and downs and boxes which will slow you down.  Advanced steering skills will make you the winner of these compelling races in one of the most fun car games of Online Games!

title: Draw the Truck Bridge
description:
We have been drawing bridges for small cars and paths for birds.  Now, are you ready for an even more challenging construction work? 
Draw the Truck Bridge is the second game of the Draw the Bridge game sequel.  With 50 unique puzzles and more diverse obstacles on your way, drawing bridges is more entertaining than ever.

title: Jeep Racing
description: Jeep Racing is a 2D driving game in which the player controls a jeep car on a bumpy road at the foot of a mountain.  It has many highs and lows.  Use your precision steering skills to navigate the treacherous terrain and avoid any potential flips because a shock could force your vehicle to roll over.  If you're up for it, we'll put you behind the wheel of one of the best driving games.

title: Unicorn Beauty Salon
description: Unicorn Beauty Salon is an online dress up game where the player's role is being a unicorn's stylist.  The player will prepare the magical unicorn, starting with her makeup, choosing her eyelashes and blush.  Then, you will complete the preparation by choosing her outfit and accessories.  As a unique stylist, you need to make her stand out among all the unicorns.

title: CobraZ.io Classic
description: CobraZ. io Classic is one of the most advanced FPS games where the player can customize his soldier and prepare himself for war with the best items.  There are 4 game modes, each with unique features.  It offers you Team Deathmatch, Free For All, Capture The Flag and Gun Game mode options.

title: Drift Hunters Pro
description:
About Drift Hunters Pro
Drift Hunters Pro is a free online 3D drifting and racing game built for players who love the sound of a screeching tire and the challenge of holding a perfect slide through a corner.  You can play solo, chasing your own high scores on six different tracks, or drop into a multiplayer room and drift alongside friends and strangers on the same server.  A garage of 10 upgradable vehicles sits at the center of the experience — every drift you land earns in-game currency you can pour back into your car, and every new car you unlock opens up a fresh way to attack the same tracks. 
Drift Hunters Pro runs entirely in the browser with no download, install, or account required, and works well on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Davo
description:
About Davo
Davo is a free online platformer developed by FreezeNova where you guide a nimble stickman through 30 increasingly punishing obstacle courses.  Every course is built from black-lined blocks with gaps you must jump across and spike-covered blocks you must avoid touching entirely, since even the slightest contact with a spike sends you right back to the start of that level.  Along the way you collect coins that unlock a growing wardrobe of costumes, from Alien Davo to Burning Davo to Davo with a Pumpkin Head, plus a long list of crazy nicknames you can equip for your stickman. 
Davo plays entirely in the browser with no download or installation required and works on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Idle Restaurant
description: How does the idea of ​​running a restaurant sound to you?  Idle Restaurant is an idle game where you operate a restaurant starting from the basics.  Starting from scratch is never easy.  But growing your restaurant is possible if you know how to manage well and take the proper steps.

title: Princess Beauty Salon
description:
About Princess Beauty Salon
Princess Beauty Salon is a free online girl game where you play the role of a beautician preparing a princess for a special invitation.  The makeover runs through three distinct stages — skincare, makeup, and dressing — starting with facial cleansing gel, a purple calming mask, a gentle peeling cream, and treatment for under-eye bags to give the princess a clear, porcelain-like base before any makeup goes on.  From there, you build a full look with eyeshadow, lipstick, and blush before finishing with a hairstyle, an outfit, shoes, a bag, and a crown fit for the occasion. 
The game runs entirely in your browser with no download required, controlled with simple mouse clicks that make it easy to pick up regardless of age or experience.

title: Dont Fall io
description:
About Dont Fall io
Dont Fall io is a free online multiplayer platform survival game where you and other players compete on a hexagonal platform that breaks apart beneath your feet.  Stay on solid tiles as long as possible while knocking rivals off the edge to claim victory.  Each round starts with a full hexagonal platform that shrinks rapidly as tiles crumble away underfoot. 
Dont Fall io runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and pits you against real players in real time.

title: Kick the Alien
description:
Kick the Alien is a wacky clicker game where an evil alien has just arrived to colonize your planet.  And your job is to give a sneaky alien the pounding it deserves. 
Every click you make sends the alien flying, earns you coins, and pushes you closer to the next level.  Use those coins to unlock wild weapons, new battlegrounds, and more.

title: Speed Drift Racing
description:
Speed Drift Racing is a free online racing game for arcade game lovers.  In a simplistic 2D setting with 3 opponents ahead of you, you will drift through sharp bends and make cool maneuvers to arrive at the finish line first. 
Get ready to test your skills on the slippery roads of Speed Drift Racing!  This online car game is all about mastering the art of precision drifting.

title: Witch Beauty Salon
description:
About Witch Beauty Salon
Witch Beauty Salon is a free online dress-up game where you play as the personal stylist for a witch whose origins date back to the 13th century.  She has come to your salon ahead of a big witch party, and it's your job to make sure she looks properly frightening among her fellow witches.  The game walks you through a full makeover in three stages — makeup, hair, and a final witchy outfit — giving you dozens of small creative choices along the way to build a look that's equal parts glamorous and eerie. 
Witch Beauty Salon runs directly in the browser with no download or install needed, using simple left-click controls that make it easy to play on desktop or touchscreen devices.

title: Crown Defense
description: The King loves to sit in his tower and drink tea, but funny red enemies are coming to bother him.  In Crown Defense, your job is to protect the King and his tower.
