If you lose a few times, do not worry.  Every time you play, you can earn coins and use them to make your tower stronger.

title: Apocalypse Truck
description: When the virus hit, cities crumbled, people vanished.  The world went silent except for the groans of the undead.  You’re one of the few survivors of zombie apocalypse.  Your only hope is a beat-up monster truck, with some spikes, plates, and just enough horsepower to push through the zombie chaos.

title: War of Ships io
description: Dominate the open seas at the helm of your ship!  War of Ships IO is a 3D pirate game where you steer your ship and try to avoid getting hit by other ships!  Survival in this arena depends on your ability to navigate and strategically engage with other ships.  You must also shoot your opponents while dodging the bullets that are trying to be thrown at you.

title: Powerslide Kart Simulator
description:
Powerslide Kart Simulator is a 3D driving game where you can enjoy driving your mini-kart and competing with other go-kart racers along curved roads.  Your aim here is mastering the art of steering a kart or other wheeled vehicles and doing stunts using the ramps on game maps.  Ignite your kart's exhaust and outshine other racers in this kart racing game!  🚦
How to Play Powerslide Kart Simulator
Enter the game, choose the game map you want to drive your vehicle on, and finally, choose one of the wheeled vehicles given to you and spawn in the game area!

title: Army Driver
description:
About Army Driver
Army Driver is a free online game that fuses war-game combat with car-driving action, putting you in a customizable jeep truck fighting through 30 levels of armed hostiles blocking the road.  There are no good guys out here — armed men line the route and won't hesitate to open fire on your vehicle, so your main mission on every level is running them down before they wreck your jeep.  Between runs, you can pick your jeep's color and upgrade its engine and suspension power using coins collected during gameplay, giving you a real sense of progression across the campaign. 
Army Driver runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, and it's built with rich, detailed graphics — from mud splashing off the jeep's tires to muzzle flashes from soldiers firing at you — that make the combat driving feel intense and dynamic.

title: Crazy Hill Climb
description:
Crazy Hill Climb is a cartoon animal racing game where the player steers a car with a unique and very sweet animal in the driver's seat.  Here, the player faces a distinct view of the road with mountains and its challenging climbs.  Are you ready to hit the road with your driver animal that you chose from the animal family? 
How to Play Crazy Hill Climb?

title: Head Soccer Football
description:
About Head Soccer Football
Head Soccer Football is a free online sports game where soccer legends face off in exaggerated, big-headed versions of themselves.  Pick from characters styled after icons like Ronaldo, Zidane, Pele, Messi, and Maradona, then head the ball into your opponent's net while defending your own goal solo — you play as both striker and goalkeeper in every match.  It's a fast, funny take on soccer that leans into over-the-top physics rather than realistic simulation, letting you head the ball at wild angles for quick, satisfying goals. 
Head Soccer Football runs entirely in your browser on desktop and mobile with no download or install required.

title: Paradise Girls
description: Paradise Girls is a 2D dress up game where the player tries to prepare the two best friends for their dreamy beach holiday.  You can imagine how excited they might be.  They have been waiting for the holiday season for a long time.  And that moment has come.

title: Shortcut Race
description:
About Shortcut Race
Shortcut Race is a free online 3D running game from Zupga where the fairest racer doesn't always win — the biggest cheater does.  You race against a crowd of wacky, wobbly characters along a twisted, jagged track laid out over open water, and the trick to winning isn't just running fast, it's collecting wooden planks along the way and using them to build shortcut bridges that cut across the course.  The more planks you stockpile, the shorter and straighter your personal route to the finish line becomes, while your rivals are left scrambling on the winding official track. 
Playable on PC, iOS, and Android with no download required, Shortcut Race runs directly in your browser and pairs vibrant 3D graphics with silly physics-based chaos, as opponents wobble, trip, and tumble into the water around you.

title: Zombie War Defense
description:
About Zombie War Defense
Zombie War Defense is a free online tower-defense-style game where you take shelter behind a gate and hold off endless waves of the undead.  Armed with a bow and arrows, you fend off zombies trying to breach your position, while a hired co-hitman backs you up with gunfire from the left side of the screen.  As waves intensify, you gain access to bombs and Molotov cocktails for clearing dense clusters of zombies, along with shop upgrades that reinforce your walls and boost your co-hitman's damage output. 
Zombie War Defense runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and it's playable on desktop devices using simple mouse-based aiming.

title: Soul Essence Adventure
description: Soul Essence Adventure is a 2D adventure game where you are stuck in a dark and gloomy castle and try to get out.  You will encounter many enemies while trying to get out of this castle.  They will try to harm you.  You need to prepare yourself for all kinds of attacks and obstacles.

title: First Day of School
description:
After a long holiday, the first day of school has arrived.  Let's see how you will prepare the girls for this day.  
First Day of School is a 2D fashion game where you're that stylist who gets the girls ready for the first day of school.  They are overly confident in you and your taste.

title: Jul Moto Racing
description:
About Jul Moto Racing
Jul Moto Racing is a free online 2D motorcycle game built around timing and reflexes.  You race your bike through city streets packed with high ramps, aiming to collect every coin in sight while unlocking new bikes across dozens of increasingly challenging levels.  Created by JulGames, it looks simple at first — you just ride, jump, and move forward — but the difficulty ramps up fast, and losing your balance means tipping over and restarting the level. 
Beyond the single-player levels, Jul Moto Racing includes a real-time online multiplayer mode where you race against other players to the finish line.

title: CS Online
description: Everyone knows the famous Counter Strike game, 2000's online battle arena with online players.  CS Online, inspired by Counter-Strike, is a multiplayer shooting game where terrorists and counter-terrorists combat and kill each other with multiple weapon options.  It is the online and free version of the original game, and you can access the CS Online on your web browser without downloading or purchasing anything.  All you need to do is join an available room and start to play!

title: Hover Racer Pro
description: Hover Racer Pro is a 3D racing game where the player steers a hover ship in a map full of jumping ramps.  This ship can go almost as fast as an airplane.  You must become an expert at driving it.  Otherwise, it can easily get out of control.

title: Evil Santa
description: Evil Santa is one of the most stress-relieving Christmas games out there in which the player tries to smash the virtual Santa.  This man was once a good man who was giving children gifts.  But, he has turned from a gift-giver into a mischief-maker.  Now that Christmas is approaching, he will appear again and do ugly things.

title: Kick the Pirate
description: Ahoy matey!  Pirates may be brave on the high seas, but they’ve never met you.  In Kick the Pirate, your job is simple: turn this grumpy pirate into your personal punching bag.   He’s muttering curses or just standing there looking smug.

title: Tile Match
description:
It’s late afternoon, and the sun is casting a soft golden glow through your little window.  You’ve got your pumpkin spice latte in hand and a cozy plaid blanket draped over your chilly legs.  Your laptop is resting nearby, waiting for you to chill out with something simple yet satisfying. 
You open a tile game on OnlineGames.

title: Motorbike Stunt Simulator
description:
About Motorbike Stunt Simulator
Motorbike Stunt Simulator is a free 3D motorcycle game built entirely around ramps, loops, and impossible tricks.  You pick from four dynamic stunt arenas, each stacked with jumps and obstacle courses designed to test how far you can push a bike before you crash.  Nailing flips, spins, and jumps racks up your stunt score, and mastering the handling on each arena is most of the challenge. 
Eight different motorbike models are unlocked from the start, including a dedicated police motorcycle with its own lights, and switching between them changes how the bike handles in the air.

title: Poop Clicker
description:
Yes, we know it's a bit of a messy situation, but we need your plumbing skills!  Play Poop Clicker, a free idle game with an odd twist; you get to be a dedicated plumber.  Click on the poo-poo on the screen to earn fantastic rewards!  
While your friends dream of glamorous careers and having cool jobs like astronauts or athletes, you've chosen a different path for being a sewer guy!

title: Army Combat
description: Whether you prefer defending or attacking, you can do both here!  Army Combat is a 3D action game where you will engage with many trained soldiers.  They are not like amateur fighters.  They go all the way.

title: Poly Racing Cars
description: Low poly is the new pixel!  For the fans of these sharp and cornered designs, we have the perfect car game that you can design your own racetracks: Poly Racing Cars is a 3D racing game with diverse player settings that cater to all kinds of racing gamers.  There are multiple modes you can enjoy.  Race on ready-made tracks against AI opponents or take on the clock in time trials.

title: Age Of Battle
description: Age Of Battle is an online strategy game that takes place in the Stone Age.  You have the most primitive soldiers as a commander in this era.  Deploy units to conquer new caves and gain strength.  Strategic moves can lead you to victory in a short time.

title: Survival Island
description: Imagine waking up on a sunny, deserted shore with the sound of waves gently rolling into pebbles on the beach.  No buildings, no people, just sand, palm trees, and hidden secrets everywhere.  Welcome to Survival Island, an exciting casual progression game where you gather, craft, explore, and survive.  Play this browser-based free game right here on OnlineGames.

title: Five Nights at Poppy
description: Ever stayed late at school or walked through a dark hallway alone and felt like something was watching you?  Did you just hear the footsteps?  Is it the wind or someone whistling?  Now imagine that same creep, but at an abandoned mental hospital where animatronic Poppy from FNAF stays in.

title: Marble Run
description:
About Marble Run
Marble Run is a free online obstacle-course game where you guide a striped beach ball across a series of narrow, candy-colored platforms suspended over open water.  Roll forward automatically, steer around spinning obstacles, and collect coins scattered along the path as you race through 30 increasingly tricky levels.  One wrong move sends your marble tumbling into the sea, so precision and timing matter more than speed.  With simple one-key controls and instant restarts, Marble Run is built for quick, replayable sessions that still reward genuine skill.

title: Agent Smith
description:
About Agent Smith
Agent Smith is a free online top-down action shooter where you play as a covert operative hunting down targets marked across each mission map.  Navigate through hostile environments, eliminate hostiles, and complete every mission without being taken down yourself.  Some targets require you to approach undetected, while others demand fast reflexes in open firefights, blending stealth with direct combat throughout. 
Agent Smith runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and its top-down view makes it easy to read the map and plan your approach to each objective.

title: Draw the Car Path
description: Draw the Car Path is an online puzzle game where you guide cars to their parking spots by drawing their paths.  It sounds simple, but as you progress, the difficulty of solving the tangled cars increases.  You'll start with a single car in an empty parking lot, but soon, you'll have to manage multiple vehicles, all while making sure they don’t crash into each other or the walls.  With 30 levels to complete, strategic thinking and precise drawing skills will be your best buddies!

title: Hill Climb Cars
description:
About Hill Climb Cars
Hill Climb Cars is a free online 2D driving game from FreezeNova where you steer a cute little car along winding roads lined with houses and shops, working your way through steep ups and downs to reach the finish line.  Across 30 unique levels of increasing difficulty, your main enemy is momentum — lean too far on a steep climb or land badly after a jump and your car will flip over, forcing you to restart the level from the beginning.  Coins earned along the way unlock new vehicles and let you customize your car's color and upgrade its engine and suspension for better handling on tougher terrain. 
Hill Climb Cars runs entirely in the browser with no download or installation required, and it's playable on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Cross the Road
description: Help the adorable frog cross the path!  Cross The Road is a 3D arcade game inspired by Crossy Road.  In the game, you guide a green frog on a vast dirt road.  While trying to cross it to the other side of the path, you will encounter many obstacles.

title: Cat Simulator
description: Purrr!  Cat Simulator is a game where you purrr a lot.  You are playing as a cat.  You have the option to choose your cat's species.

title: Fun Party Makeup
description:
About Fun Party Makeup
Fun Party Makeup is a free online makeup and dress-up game, developed by FreezeNova, where you prepare four different girls for a variety of special occasions — birthdays, bachelorette parties, engagements, and baby showers.  You take on four roles at once: skincare specialist, hairdresser, makeup artist, and personal fashion advisor, guiding each girl from a bare face all the way to a fully styled, party-ready look.  Since it's meant to be fun rather than realistic, you're free to go as bold and glamorous as you like with every choice. 
Fun Party Makeup runs entirely in your browser on desktop and mobile with no download or install required.

title: Bus Subway Runner
description: There is no end to this chase… Bus Subway Runner is an enjoyable runner game where you are being chased by a policeman.  You remember Subway Surfer, right?  There you were racing against trains.  In Bus Subway Runner, you will be facing buses!

title: City Stunts
description: City Stunts is a 3D driving game where your main job is to perform spectacular stunts with the most exotic cars in the world.  Test your driving skills on high ramps.  Many platforms on the city map allow you to make acrobatic movements with your vehicle.  Choose your favorite vehicle and challenge the sky in this thrilling stunt game!

title: Galactic Sniper
description:
About Galactic Sniper
Galactic Sniper is a free online sniper shooting game developed by FreezeNova that casts you as the sharpshooter of an elite team investigating a newly discovered planet.  Humanoid mech robots deployed by aliens are spying on your research base, and your job across 30 levels of increasing difficulty is to take them down one by one before they gather too much intel.  Early levels start you off against stationary spy robots with just a few bullets, while later levels introduce faster, moving mechs that demand precise timing to hit. 
The game runs entirely in your browser with no download required and is built with intuitive controls that work equally well on computers and mobile devices.

title: Idle Dev Startup
description: Idle Dev Startup is an idle clicker game where the player takes on the role of a software developer trying to make and market applications as a means of making money.  This business endeavor will necessitate a complete start from scratch.  You must, therefore, exercise patience while the company expands.  You'll be glad to see the success of your startup in time!

title: Jacks Village
description:
About Jacks Village
Jacks Village is a free online 3D first-person hero game where you play as Jack, defending your medieval village from waves of giant invading creatures with the help of local civilians.  The game splits into two ways to play: a 15-mission Campaign mode with escalating objectives, like clearing 7 monsters in your very first mission using only a starting dagger, and an Endless mode where you roam the village freely while monsters continue to hunt you down.  A medieval arsenal — dagger, mace, axe, sword, and bow with arrows — gives you several ways to fight back as you progress. 
Jacks Village runs entirely in your browser with no download required, playable on desktop with keyboard and mouse controls.

title: Owl and Rabbit Fashion
description:
About Owl and Rabbit Fashion
Owl and Rabbit Fashion is a free online dress-up game that puts you in the role of personal stylist to a pair of trusting animal clients: a fluffy rabbit and a wide-eyed owl.  Instead of styling people, you're working with fur and feathers, picking a base color, eye color, hair band, sticker, outfit, shoes, and optional accessories for each pet.  With a full wardrobe of casual clothes, sneakers, slippers, necklaces, and glasses to choose from, no two makeovers have to look the same. 
Owl and Rabbit Fashion plays entirely in the browser with no download required, and its simple point-and-click interface makes it comfortable on both desktop and mobile screens.

title: Jeep Driver
description:
About Jeep Driver
Jeep Driver is a free, cartoon-styled off-road driving game from JulGames that's all about balance, speed, and momentum.  You take the wheel of a tough little jeep and work your way through 30 levels of bumpy desert roads, wobbly bridges, ramps, and gaps, with a single goal on every stage: keep moving forward without crashing or flipping over.  Along the way you collect coins, which unlock new jeeps — from sleek desert rides to rugged off-road monsters — plus performance upgrades and color customization for your ride. 
Jeep Driver plays free in the browser with no download or account needed, and runs smoothly on desktop and mobile.

title: CubeCraft Survival
description: CubeCraft Survival is an online survival game inspired by Minecraft.  The survival of the players depends on their strategy and crafting skills.  In a dynamic open world, players are supposed to explore, craft and battle against the hostile creatures.  There are as many dangers as there are opportunities in this blocky world!

title: Monster Truck Mountain Climb
description:
About Monster Truck Mountain Climb
Monster Truck Mountain Climb is a free online 2D driving game that puts you behind the wheel of a powerful monster truck facing 30 off-road challenges across rugged, hilly terrain.  Every steep climb, sharp descent, and mid-air jump tests both your driving instincts and your truck's durability, since a hard enough crash will make it explode and force you to restart the level.  Along the way you collect coins, perform mid-air flips for bonus rewards, and use your earnings to unlock new trucks and upgrade your engine and brakes. 
Monster Truck Mountain Climb runs entirely in the browser with no download required, using simple keyboard controls that work equally well for quick sessions or longer runs through its full level set.

title: Football King
description:
Are you ready to shake things up in unique stadiums?  Football King is a 2D sports game in which you direct your football player and try to score as many goals as you can.  In the two-player mode, you can challenge your friend on the field. 
Or, play against the CPU in the single-player mode.

title: Highway Racer 2
description:
Are you ready to raise clouds of dust on the highway?  Highway Racer 2 is a 3D car driving game where your main goal is passing by sharp maneuvers as close as possible to the sides of cars on the highway.  I know this is very dangerous, but it makes your adrenaline skyrocket! 
How to Play Highway Racer 2?

title: Offroad Rally
description:
About Offroad Rally
Offroad Rally is a free online 3D racing game where you race a truck across muddy, obstacle-strewn off-road tracks instead of a clean asphalt circuit.  Soil patches, rocks, and scattered driftwood litter every course, and even a small piece of wood can knock you out of first place if you hit it carelessly, so knowing when to brake and when to accelerate matters more than raw speed.  A nitro boost, collectible blue F coins, and a garage full of truck upgrades give you extra tools to gain an edge over the competition. 
Offroad Rally runs entirely in your browser with no download required, playable on desktop with keyboard controls.

title: Egg Car Racing
description: Egg Car Racing is an online car game where the goal is simple but quirky— keep a fragile egg safe while navigating a bumpy terrain.  This free game will test your driving skills, timing, and ability to stay calm under pressure as you race across 30 challenging levels.  Can you protect the egg through every twist and turn?  Play now and find out!

title: Fast Food Rush
description: You're at Burger King, sinking your teeth into a juicy cheeseburger and finishing it off in about 15 minutes flat.  But just this once, before you head out, pause and take a quick look around.  Employees are rushing nonstop, flipping sizzling patties, taking orders at the counter, pouring ice-cold drinks, and wiping down tables.  At this point, running your own burger joint might seem pretty appealing, at least to some people.

title: Pinball Simulator
description: Insert your virtual token and start to play!  Pinball Simulator is a simulator arcade game where you can play the ancient pinball game on a digital platform for free!  It offers you two different themes: Day of Dead and Octopus Island.  Choose which theme you want to play on, and try to keep the ball in the game!

title: Train Racing
description:
Prepare for an adrenaline rush like no other in "Train Racing," the ultimate high-speed train racing game!  Put yourself in the shoes of a courageous locomotive conductor and take command of some of the world's fastest and most potent trains as you fight against rough roads with steep ups and downs.  Collect the money while racing; thus, you can use those coins to buy the latest train models. 
How to Play Train Racing?

title: Romantic Secret Kiss
description:
About Romantic Secret Kiss
Romantic Secret Kiss is a free online love-themed game where you help two sweethearts steal kisses in a park overlooking the Eiffel Tower in Paris, all without getting caught.  An artist sits nearby painting the tower, and the couple must only kiss while his back is turned — an exclamation mark warns you when he's about to look their way.  Each successful kiss fills the love meter in the upper left corner, and once it's full you advance to a tougher level where more onlookers show up to complicate your timing. 
Romantic Secret Kiss runs entirely in your browser and is compatible with Android and iOS devices, Chromebooks, desktops, and tablets, with no download or account required.

title: Kick the Zombie
description: Do you remember computers before the Internet?  The times we used to play desktop destruction games...  You would pick the hammer and crash the screen until it breaks into a thousand pieces virtually.  If you're a 90's kid who used to enjoy desktop destroyers, here is the new generation of stress relief: Kick the Zombie!

title: City Police Cars
description:
About City Police Cars
City Police Cars is a free online side-scrolling action game where justice drives on four wheels.  You take the wheel of a police cruiser, patrolling crowded city streets and jumping straight into the action to eliminate dangerous criminals blocking your path.  Collect coins as you go to unlock new vehicles and take on tougher missions, with each stage throwing more aggressive enemies and trickier obstacles in your way. 
City Police Cars runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, and works well on both desktop and mobile devices with simple tap controls.

title: Monster Truck City Parking
description: Monster Truck City Parking is a driving game where you follow the pink halos with your giant truck and go to the parking area.  You must park your vehicle in the area before your time is up.  When you reach the parking lot, gently get your vehicle in.  The real challenge in this one of the most enjoyable parking games is properly fitting the huge vehicle into the parking space!

title: Darkness Survivors
description:
Are you ready to battle with the darkness minions?  Darkness Survivors is a 2D action game where you try to remove dark creatures from the battlefield.  You have various hero characters to choose from. 
Just decide whether you want to slay them using a sword, boomerangs or other weapons.

title: Monster Truck Booster
description:
Monster Truck Booster is here to take your gaming experience to new heights—literally.  This online 2D driving game combines classic monster truck mechanics with a quirky twist: a powerful booster that launches your truck into the air.  Whether you're climbing steep slopes or leaping over wild ramps, the challenge is all about precision and flair. 
But what makes this game truly stand out?

title: Sweet Sugar Match
description: Sweet Sugar Match is a 2D puzzle game where you try to match sweet candies of the same color.  Swipe the candies to create a series of 3 or more matching colorful sugars.  When you match them, that series of blocks disappears, and the blocks on top come down.  Match the candies just like you did in Candy Crush!

title: Limousine Simulator
description:
About Limousine Simulator
Limousine Simulator is a free online 2D driving game from FreezeNova that puts you in the driver's seat as a private chauffeur for the rich and famous.  Across 25 levels, you pick up demanding passengers — businesspeople, actresses, and even royalty — and are responsible for giving them a smooth, safe ride to their destination before parking the stretch limo precisely in a designated spot.  Every level starts you with 3 stars, and every bump or rough moment costs you half a star, while hitting a waiting passenger costs you all three at once, so careful, controlled driving matters more than raw speed. 
Limousine Simulator runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, and it's playable on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: ToonZ io
description:
About ToonZ io
ToonZ io is a free online multiplayer shooting game with a cartoonish art style and a surprisingly deep combat system built around both guns and melee weapons.  You pick a game mode and a map, then drop into matches against other online players — either Team Deathmatch or Free Killing — where every weapon you use has its own stats for Damage, Fire Rate or Attack Speed, Accuracy, Critical chance, and special Ability.  Earn currency and frags in matches, then spend them upgrading your existing arsenal or buying new guns and melee weapons entirely. 
ToonZ io runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, and its bright, toon-style visuals keep the chaos of multiplayer combat easy to read even in a crowded fight.

title: Galactic Driver
description:
About Galactic Driver
Galactic Driver is a free online driving game developed by FreezeNova set in a stylized sci-fi city.  The goal in each of its 30 levels is straightforward: drive your car across an obstacle course and reach the finish line before it explodes.  The controls are easy to pick up, but timing is everything — some obstacles need to be tackled at speed while others require you to slow down and ease over them carefully, and not knowing what's coming next keeps every run tense. 
Built to run entirely in the browser with no download required, Galactic Driver is accessible on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Kingdom Attack
description: Kingdom Attack offers a fascinating game world where many different creatures live.  Employ spirited knights, witches and archers in your army.  Upgrade your towers to their most potent.  Then, get ready to defend your kingdom from zombies, dragons, and other shapeless creatures on the battlefield.

title: Skateboard Marathon
description: Skateboard Marathon is a 3D racing game where you slide with your board on a platform.  Maximize your gaming pleasure by making your skater perform eccentric movements and maneuvers.  Once you find your balance point, you can try anything on a skateboard.  Just hop on your board and enjoy the game!

title: SpartaHoppers
description: Have you heard about Sparta before?  The ancient Roman city where warriors once clashed on grand stages.  They were the coolest guys of their era.  Only, in this online game, your gladiators can’t walk cuz they can only hop!

title: Kawaii Shooter
description:
About Kawaii Shooter
Kawaii Shooter, developed by FreezeNova, is a free online first-person shooter that wraps run-and-gun combat in an adorable, pastel-colored world.  Cute little creatures called Kawaiis have been possessed by evil spirits, and despite their lovable appearance, they'll attack the moment they sense you in their charming land, leaving you no choice but to fight your way through.  You blast through wave after wave of Kawaii enemies across increasingly difficult stages, picking up coins to upgrade your character and unlocking new weapons as you push deeper into each season. 
Kawaii Shooter plays entirely in your browser on desktop with no download or install required, using standard WASD-and-mouse FPS controls that will feel instantly familiar to shooter fans.

title: Dinosaur Game
description: Do you remember the T-Rex in Google Chrome when your internet connection went out?  Now, you can play it online, too.  Dinosaur Game is a free-running game where there is no finish line.  We warn you in advance that this is a challenging game.

title: Mini Shooters
description:
About Mini Shooters
Mini Shooters is a free online compact but action-packed multiplayer shooter where your mini character battles other players in arena-style combat.  Shoot, dodge, collect coins to restore health, and fight your way to the top of the leaderboard.  Coins dropped by defeated enemies restore your health, making every kill doubly rewarding in a match. 
Mini Shooters runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and its compact map keeps encounters constant and intensity high throughout every match.

title: Wedding Beauty Salon
description: There is a wedding coming up.  Wedding preparations have already started.  The organization team has been working well.  Now it is the wedding day.

title: Subway Idle 3D
description: Subway Idle 3D is an idle game where you try to run an underground network in New York City.  You are in charge of all engineering work of this subway system.  You will be the head of the construction.  Can you imagine how much this system is needed in a crowded city like New York?

title: Speedrun Parkour
description:
Alex, a young boy with great athletic abilities, finds himself in a port.  He is chased by the bad guys of the port.  His only way out is to navigate a series of heart-pounding challenges, leaping, rolling, and climbing over containers, boxes, and various other objects scattered in the sky. 
Your mission is to guide him to safety.

title: Rescue Helicopter
description:
About Rescue Helicopter
Rescue Helicopter is a free online 2D helicopter game where you play as the only pilot standing between stranded people and disaster.  People trapped on rooftops need saving, and it's your job to fly in, drop a rescue rope, and carry them to safety.  Approach each person carefully, let them grab hold of the rope dangling below your helicopter, and then fly them to the designated landing zone to complete the rescue and win the level. 
Rescue Helicopter runs entirely in your browser with no download required, and is fully playable on mobile phone, desktop, tablet, or Chromebook with a stable internet connection.

title: Princesses Prom Night
description:
About Princesses Prom Night
Princesses Prom Night is a free online dress-up game where you take on the role of a trusted stylist preparing a group of princesses for the most important night of their academic year: prom.  As the girls arrive at your beauty center, it's entirely up to you to handle their makeup, hairstyling, and outfit choices, making sure every princess walks in looking like she belongs on a magazine cover.  With full control over eye makeup, lipstick, blush, eyebrows, hair, dresses, shoes, and bags, the game gives you real creative freedom to design a distinct prom look for each princess. 
Princesses Prom Night runs entirely in your browser with no download required, using simple point-and-click and drag interactions that make it easy to play on desktop or mobile.

title: Pets Beauty Salon
description:
About Pets Beauty Salon
Pets Beauty Salon is a free online dress-up game where you become a professional pet stylist for adorable cats and dogs.  Instead of makeup and fashion aimed at people, this kids' game turns your creativity toward furry customers: you pick a base coat color, choose expressive eye colors, apply fun stickers like hearts, stars, paw prints, and donuts, then finish the look with hats, crowns, ribbons, sweaters, skirts, shoes, collars, scarves, and glasses.  With bright, cheerful graphics and a huge wardrobe of options, every pet you style can come out looking completely different from the last. 
Pets Beauty Salon runs entirely in your browser with no download or installation needed, and it works smoothly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

title: ATV Highway Traffic
description: Shall we tour the city with an ATV vehicle?  It sounds like it could be a lot of fun.  Atv Highway Traffic is a 3D driving game where you steer a 4-wheel vehicle.  There are four maps to steer your car: a highway road, a desert road, a snowy road, and a city map.

title: Paw Clicker
description:
About Paw Clicker
Paw Clicker is a free online idle clicker game where you tap on adorable animals to earn shiny paw coins.  Every tap adds to your total, and once you invest in upgrades, coins keep rolling in passively even when you're not actively clicking.  The core loop is simple and addictive: tap, spend, and unlock — with new animal skins, cute accessories, and different backdrop environments waiting as rewards for steady progress. 
Playable free in the browser or on mobile with just a tap or click, Paw Clicker doesn't require any download or installation.

title: Skibidi Toilet io
description: Have you ever heard of a game called Skibidi Toilet io?  It's a rather absurd concept - a battle royale game where toilets run around like crazy.  The aim of the game is for the toilets to compete with each other by eating as much toilet paper and hot peppers as possible.  As they consume more, they become bigger and stronger.

title: Formula 1 Driver
description:
About Formula 1 Driver
Formula 1 Driver is a free online 2D driving game that puts you behind the wheel of a customizable F1 vehicle with every spectator's eyes on you.  The goal is simple to explain but hard to master: race down a rough, hilly track, collect coins along the way, and reach the finish line without flipping your car.  Before each race you can open the customization menu from the steering-wheel icon on the main menu to choose your vehicle's color and boost its engine and suspension power, with new vehicles unlocking as you earn money from completed races. 
Formula 1 Driver plays directly in your browser with no download required, and supports a Multiplayer mode where you can race up to three other players in the same room by creating or joining one from the level select screen.

title: Zombie Road
description: Zombie Road is a 3D browser game where you steer a vehicle with lethal blades in front.  You will see zombies along the highway.  Drive your car on them without stopping once.  The blades will remove them from your way.

title: War Simulator
description:
A medieval war strategist commanding an army of diverse units such as archers, spearmen, and dwarves - that's who you get to be on War Simulator!  Deploy your warriors with a strategic formation and conquer new lands in this online game!  Use your wits to outmaneuver your enemies and secure victory! 
Controls

Left Click to place warriors on the battlefield.

title: Head Basketball
description:
About Head Basketball
Head Basketball is a free online one-on-one basketball game where you take control of a big-headed version of a famous NBA-style player and battle a rival for the highest score.  The goal is simple — sink the ball into your opponent's basket more times than they sink it into yours before the clock runs out.  Between matches, you can pick your player, choose their jersey and shoes (including some deliberately silly options like high heels), select the ball type, and set the court, giving every match a slightly different look and feel. 
Head Basketball runs entirely in the browser with no download or install required, using simple keyboard controls that make it easy to pick up but genuinely challenging to master against the AI.

title: Xmas Cookie Clicker
description: Ho Ho Ho!  It's the most wonderful time of the year!  Start kneading the dough; everybody is waiting for their Christmas cookies.  This is a job requiring speed.

title: Mafia Getaway Cars
description:
Mafia Getaway Cars is a 2D driving game where you’re driving, escaping, shooting, and occasionally flipping your 1930s mob-mobile over a suspiciously placed slope.  If you ever wondered what it’s like to be a vintage gangster on the run with terrible road planning and way too many enemies, this online game is your dream (or nightmare). 
Put on your best fedora, hop into your sketchy-looking getaway car, and floor it.  The cops are mad, the rival gangs are really mad, and gravity?

title: Mech Shooter
description: Mech Shooter is a 3D robot shooting game where you, in the shoes of Humanoid Mech, will deal with many robots trying to destroy you and your team.  The game map can be a factory or somewhere in the city.  No matter where you are, you will be with your teammates.  Use your Minigun and eliminate all enemy forces in one of the most thrilling action games on Online Games!

title: Snake Wars
description: Snake Wars is a fun io game where you embody a cute snake trying to get bigger by eating food.  You must be the biggest one among the others in the pit.  Otherwise, you will become prey for them.  Avoid crashing with any other ones to achieve success in this thrilling snake game!

title: Steal Brainrot Heist
description:
About Steal Brainrot Heist
Steal Brainrot Heist is a free online Italian brainrot game developed by FreezeNova where you hunt down funny brainrot characters and bring them back to your base to earn idle income.  Every character you place at your base earns you money automatically every second, with rarer characters like Godzillone Celestino paying out far more than common ones like Bombardiro.  But building a fortune isn't just about collecting — other players can raid your base and steal your characters, so defending your territory is just as important as expanding it. 
Steal Brainrot Heist runs entirely in your browser with no download required, blending idle-game income mechanics with light PvP raiding in a chaotic, meme-inspired world.

title: Storm City Mafia
description: Welcome to the world of cyberpunk!  Storm City Mafia is a themed mafia game with many missions.  Each task must be accomplished successfully.  You are the key in this cyber world.

title: The Farmer
description: The Farmer is a 3D farming simulator game where the player cultivates the field, sows the seeds, waters them and carries out pesticide operations with a tractor.  It is a game where the players can perform every operation they can think of in the field of farming.  It is also a realistic simulation game for those who want to enter this field in real life.  Get in the seat of your tractor, take the necessary farm tools and head to your land in this virtual farming world!

title: Monster Truck Race Arena
description:
About Monster Truck Race Arena
Monster Truck Race Arena is a free online 2D racing game from FreezeNova where flipping your truck upside down is the fastest way to end your run.  You drive rough off-road tracks packed with ramps, jumps, and tilted terrain, racing against other monster trucks while trying to land every stunt cleanly — one bad landing sends your truck crashing and exploding, restarting you from the beginning of the level.  You start with a basic yellow truck with red flames and can chase coins across 24 levels to unlock new trucks, including shark-shaped designs, and to upgrade your engine power and nitro capacity for a real edge over the competition. 
Monster Truck Race Arena runs entirely in the browser with no download required, making it a great pick-up-and-play racer for quick sessions on desktop or mobile.

title: Draw Here
description: Draw Here is a physics puzzle game with 100 levels.  Draw objects on the canvas to collect all the stars.  Use your basic physics knowledge besides drawing skills.  Gravity, motion and energy conversion are all in this game.

title: Legends Arena
description: Legends Arena is an online shooting game where you battle with your enemies as a team.  There are many game options.  You can play in 2v2, 3v3 and 5v5 modes.  The 5v5 option is exclusively on the Battle Stage map.

title: Hook Wars
description: Hook Wars is a 3D battle game where you need to avoid being hooked by the avatars across the river.  In the meantime, you will try to hook them and get them to your side.  Precise aiming is crucial here.  Challenge yourself to achieve the highest scores each time you try in this action game!

title: Baby Beauty Salon
description:
Before you take baby girls to the park, you need to prepare them.  Baby Beauty Salon is a 2D girl game where you are the stylist of the four baby girls.  You need to make them the most adorable girls among other babies in the neighborhood park. 
Start with their makeup, dress them up and put nail polish on them.

title: Funny Shooter Bro
description:
Funny Shooter Bro is a web-based FPS game with funny-looking enemies and bizarre sound effects.  
Spawn onto the map alone with your trusty weapon.  All redmen hates strangers in this town.  They will not hold back from running over you with sticks when they spot you.

title: Run FreezeNova
description: Run FreezeNova is a fast-paced arcade game where you help the FreezeNova mascot dodge through all the obstacles on his way in outer space.  In this endless running adventure, you need to fight against gravity.  Avoid falling into the void and run as far as you can.  Take the farthest route to write your name on the leaderboard!

title: Treasure Hunter
description: The tomb is filled with giant chests and treasures, each promising incredible wealth.  Enter the chamber and hunt for every single one.  But wait, what’s that?  Something is lurking in the shadows?

title: Dockyard Tank Parking
description: Dockyard Tank Parking is a 3D tank driving game where you steer a huge machine and try to park it in the specified parking area.  It is one of the most unusual parking games.  Fitting the giant tank into a narrow zone will not be that easy!  You must park it into the zone properly to move to the next level.

title: Hover Racer
description:
About Hover Racer
Hover Racer is a free online 3D racing game that swaps traditional cars for futuristic hovercraft, dropping you into a sci-fi world of high-speed racing and combat.  You choose between three hovers — Thunder, Wolf, and the diamond-unlockable Mystral — and race across three distinct environments: Terrain, Space, and Barrel tracks.  It isn't just about speed, either; a Left Shift key fires ammunition at rival racers, letting you throw paint and slow down anyone threatening to pass you. 
Hover Racer runs entirely in your browser on OnlineGames.

title: Truck Racing
description:
About Truck Racing
Truck Racing is a free online driving game developed by FreezeNova where you play as a delivery truck driver tasked with transporting cargo boxes from one warehouse to another without damaging them.  Each run loads your truck with a single box, and the road ahead is filled with bumps, ramps, and obstacles that can knock the cargo loose or damage it if you drive carelessly.  Successful deliveries earn coins, which you can spend on upgrading your truck's engine and suspension or on buying an entirely new truck with better grip and safety. 
Truck Racing runs directly in your browser with no download required, and it's playable on both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Squid Race Simulator
description:
About Squid Race Simulator
Squid Race Simulator is a free online reaction game that recreates the tense Red Light, Green Light challenge made famous by the hit Korean series Squid Game.  You control a runner racing toward the finish line, tapping or clicking to move forward and releasing the instant the giant doll turns around.  Move on red and you are instantly eliminated, so every round is a test of nerve, timing, and self-control rather than raw speed.  With multiple levels that ramp up the doll's reaction speed and shrink your margin for error, the game turns a simple stop-and-go mechanic into a genuinely nerve-wracking survival challenge.

title: Monster Truck Racing
description:
Giant wheels and incredible engine power—Monster Trucks are amazing machines built for high performance on rough terrains.  In this mini-game, players race to the finish line with monster trucks on an obstacle course.  Drive your truck, perform jumps and flips, and be the first to reach the flag. 
Monster Truck Racing is a 2D single-player racing game where you'll strive to outpace opponents on steep tracks.

title: Blocky Blast
description: Blocky Blast is a 2D puzzle game where you try to blast the cubes of the same color on the grid.  Tap on the neighbor cubes with matching colors to remove them altogether.  Continue removing cubes until you fulfill the task of the level.  However, be mindful that you have a limited number of moves.

title: Draw the Bird Path
description:
About Draw the Bird Path
Draw the Bird Path is a free online drawing puzzle game where you guide sweet little birds home by sketching the exact route they should fly.  Across 30 levels, you draw a path with your mouse that steers each bird around obstacles and safely into its nest, and the challenge escalates quickly once multiple birds need to fly at the same time without crashing into each other. 
Draw the Bird Path plays entirely in the browser with no download needed, and its simple mouse-only controls make it easy to pick up on both desktop and touch devices.  The charming art style and gradually increasing puzzle complexity make it a relaxing but genuinely brain-teasing puzzle experience.

title: Futuristic Racer
description:
About Futuristic Racer
Futuristic Racer is a free online racing game set in the year 2149, where you compete across neon-lit, high-tech cityscapes for galactic racing supremacy.  Developed by JulGames, the game starts you off in a basic car and challenges you to complete 30 increasingly tough levels, collecting every gem on each track and finishing in the top 3 to progress.  Miss the podium or crash out, and you'll be sent back to try that level again, so precision handling matters as much as raw speed. 
Futuristic Racer runs entirely in your browser with no download or install required, and its easy-to-learn but hard-to-master controls make it approachable for newcomers while still rewarding players who master its nitro timing.

title: Egg Helix
description: Egg Helix is an arcade game where you steer a trunk adorned with many tennis rackets.  There will be an easter egg bouncing up and down.  Your main purpose is to take this egg to the top.  Make eggcelent steering movements to achieve it.

title: Dino Chaos Idle
description: Dino Chaos Idle is an idle clicker game where you give life to the dinosaurs.  You will enable them to create chaos on the surface by resurrecting them.  Many scientists will work with you while you are working underground.  Each of the scientists has their own specific formula for the job.

title: Run 3 Space
description: Run 3 Space is a 3D arcade game where you help the spaceman run through the tunnel with obstacles on a galactical dimension.  You need to guide this spaceman through the tunnel and bring him to the blue portal at the end of the platform.  But you need to pay attention to the tiles on the platform.  You will see gaps in some places.

title: Racing Cars 2
description:
Racing Cars 2 is a driving game where you will steer your car on a city road.  However, the road will test your driving skills with ups and downs.  You cannot lose control of the car! 
Otherwise, the car can turn upside down, which will cause it to explode.

title: Mr Space Bullet
description:
Mr Space Bullet is a 2D shooting game where you will be on a staircase in outer space.  While trying to climb up, you will come across many aliens on your way.  Your job is to aim at your enemies precisely at their heads. 
Shoot the alien you encounter on every stair without blinking an eye.

title: Geometry Rash
description: The little square loves to dance!  Dangerous obstacles keep coming on his way.  Follow the rhythm, let him jump over the obstacles, and keep him out of trouble!  It may sound simple, but Geometry Rash is a 2D action platformer game requiring very fast response.
